nodes.name: Clinical medicine
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. Landmark node (six dependents, three live unlocks).

prereqAssessment.why: Clinical medicine builds on the written record of cases.

nodes.effectRationale: Trained physicians: the operand by which university medicine saves lives. Also the live hospital and university buildings.

nodes.name: Cast and mosaic glass
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Successor technique of core-formed glass.

nodes.effectRationale: Cast and mosaic glass vessels are a luxury workshop industry employing specialist glassworkers.

nodes.name: Rotary quern
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Direct lineage of the quern.
Rotary motion on an axle.

nodes.name: Beam press
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND. Deliberate leaf; oil export volumes are its game role.

prereqAssessment.why: The beam press is a better oil press.
Press beds, weights and anchor stones are cut and set stone.

nodes.name: Axiomatic geometry
nodes.auditRationale: Kept. Live: one of the two OR paths to building.university (with medicine_hippocratic). A Greek-alphabet atom was considered and rejected: the capability is the proof method, not the script.

prereqAssessment.why: Euclid systematises Egyptian and Babylonian rules into proofs.

nodes.effectRationale: Proof from stated axioms makes knowledge transmissible from the text alone (the Elements was taught for 2,000 years): universities mature faster.

nodes.name: Statics and simple machines
nodes.auditRationale: Kept; four dependents (barometer, gearing, press, water screw).

prereqAssessment.why: The law of the lever and centre-of-gravity results are Euclidean demonstrations.

nodes.effectRationale: Calculated levers and compound pulleys move building loads with fewer hands.

nodes.name: Torsion catapult
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate leaf. Philo's calibration formula (~250 BCE) is later than the node date but not a requirement.

prereqAssessment.why: The gastraphetes (belly-bow) is the stated ancestor of torsion engines.

nodes.effectRationale: Bolt-throwers on the walls let small garrisons hold frontier towns, extending the reach of administration.

nodes.name: Water screw
nodes.auditRationale: Correct, single causal prerequisite.

prereqAssessment.why: The screw is the Archimedean helix applied to lifting.

nodes.name: Water-lifting wheel
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND. Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: A bucket wheel is a wheel on an axle.
The noria lifts from a channel or river into an irrigation system.

nodes.name: Water mill
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisite kept. gearing (~150 BCE) is not added: the earliest mills (Perachora ~300 BCE horizontal mill) need no right-angle gearing and the node predates gearing. Live unlocks retained.

prereqAssessment.why: The mill drives a rotary millstone pair; the quern gives the stone geometry and the rynd/spindle.

nodes.effectRationale: Hand-grinding grain consumed hours of household labour daily; a mill releases that labour to the fields. Landmark node (first non-muscle prime mover), hence a larger delta.

nodes.name: Water-powered trip hammer
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisite correct; China first (Han ~40 BCE). Effect differs from water_mill (extraction vs farm labour).

prereqAssessment.why: A cam on a water-wheel shaft lifting a hammer: needs the water-power wheel.

nodes.effectRationale: Water-driven stamps crush ore at the mine and hull grain, multiplying what each extractor delivers.

nodes.name: Gear trains
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND.

prereqAssessment.why: Gear theory and calculation rest on Hellenistic mechanics.
Bronze gear blanks are cast; the Antikythera gears are cut bronze sheet and castings.

nodes.name: Hydraulic concrete
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Burnt lime is the binder.

nodes.effectRationale: Hydraulic concrete strengthens with age and sets underwater: durable buildings, and artificial harbour moles that cut shipping costs.

nodes.name: Vault and dome
nodes.prereq: arch AND (concrete_pozzolan OR fired_brick OR ashlar_masonry)
nodes.auditRationale: arch AND (any vaulting material) is the right shape.

prereqAssessment.why: Vaults and domes are arches extended or rotated.
Roman concrete vaults; alternative route, OR is right.
Brick vaults (Byzantine, Sasanian); alternative route.
Cut-stone vaults; alternative route.

nodes.name: Engineered paved road
nodes.auditRationale: Add track_road: the road-building craft (causeway, drainage, graded track) is the lineage of the engineered road, and the infrastructure ladder is road_track -> road_built -> road_paved. Without the edge a polity can build paved roads without ever knowing trackways; both atoms are A2/A3, so no sweep or chronology risk.

prereqAssessment.why: Engineered roads are laid out on surveyed alignments and grades (Via Appia).

nodes.name: Stone arch bridge
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND/OR. Deliberate leaf; its value is the live bridge.

prereqAssessment.why: A stone bridge is a chain of arches.
Roman bridge piers in concrete; alternative.
Cut-stone voussoirs; alternative.

nodes.name: Arcaded aqueduct
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND. Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: The arcade carries the gravity channel.
Arcades are tiers of arches.

nodes.name: Glassblowing
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Hot-glass working tradition.
The blowpipe is an iron tube.

nodes.effectRationale: Cheap blown bottles and flasks became standard containers for oil, wine and medicine: stocks move to market faster.

nodes.name: Window glass
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. The description says 'cast' panes; glass_blown_precursor (casting) would be the narrower atom, but cheapness came from the blowing industry, so the edge stands.

prereqAssessment.why: Roman panes were cast in the blown-glass workshops; blowing made glass cheap enough to glaze windows.

nodes.effectRationale: Glazed windows let homes, baths and sickrooms keep heat while admitting light: less cold-season illness.

nodes.name: Cast iron
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Strong piston bellows raise the furnace above 1,150 C.
Pouring into moulds.
Iron ore smelting.

nodes.effectRationale: Mass-cast ploughshares, hoes and cookware from state ironworks reach every farmer; blast furnace unlocked.

nodes.name: Iron mouldboard plough
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Han shares and mouldboards were cast iron.
Plough lineage.

nodes.name: Seed drill
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: The Han drill is a multi-tube ard.
Cast-iron coulters.

nodes.name: Breast-strap harness
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites causal; the effect is load per animal, hence bulk haulage cost.

prereqAssessment.why: The harness is for horse traction.
The breast strap is stitched leather; sewing is the material precondition.

nodes.name: Paper
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisite is the causal material craft. Effect is administrative scale (its desc: bureaucratic scale).

prereqAssessment.why: Paper is macerated plant fibre (hemp rag, bark, ramie); processing fibre into cordage and cloth supplies the raw material and the retting craft.

nodes.name: Repeating crossbow
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate leaf. Paired effect keeps it distinct from the A4 crossbow's single unrest effect.

prereqAssessment.why: A magazine added to the crossbow.

nodes.effectRationale: A cheap rapid-fire weapon for household and village defence: disorder costs less, and settler parties can defend themselves.

nodes.name: Stirrup
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. The link between stirrup and feudal levy is contested (White's thesis); the effect is stated as mounted coercion, not as the cause of feudalism.

prereqAssessment.why: The stirrup is fixed to a saddle.
The earliest (302 CE) stirrups were gilt bronze or wood, but the forms that spread with the Avars were iron; kept.

nodes.effectRationale: Heavy horsemen maintained from estates enforce lordly and royal dues over the countryside: taxes extract more.

nodes.name: Sericulture
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND. The node is the root of the figured-silk branch (drawloom).

prereqAssessment.why: Silk is a weaving fibre; a loom is needed.
Mulberry cultivation is tree-crop husbandry.

nodes.name: Lacquerware
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate regional leaf (East Asian craft).

prereqAssessment.why: Lacquer is a cured tree-sap binder, the same material family.

nodes.effectRationale: Layered sap coatings waterproof and protect wood: lacquered timber lasts longer.

nodes.name: Geometric astronomy
nodes.auditRationale: Kept. Live: an OR path to building.observatory.

prereqAssessment.why: Epicycle and eccentric models are geometric constructions.
Hipparchus built on Babylonian eclipse records kept against the intercalated calendar.

nodes.effectRationale: Shared predictive tables (the Almagest) give every later scholar a common computed reference: research in universities costs less.

nodes.name: Mathematical cartography
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; the effect is the range of planned exploration.

prereqAssessment.why: Ptolemy's maps place places by latitude and longitude derived from geometric astronomy.

nodes.name: Latitude by celestial observation
nodes.auditRationale: OR between two independent star-knowledge traditions is correct; astronomy_records is dated after the node but is not must-held.

prereqAssessment.why: Star rising and zenith observations (Babylonian records, Polynesian star compass) give latitude.
Alternative oral sky-knowledge tradition; OR is right because Polynesian wayfinding did not depend on written records.

nodes.name: Monsoon navigation
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; effect is market integration across the ocean basin.

prereqAssessment.why: Running before the seasonal wind needs sail.
The monsoon calendar (when to sail out and back) is kept by sky observation.

nodes.name: Lateen sail
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; effect differs from its A5 lane neighbours (exploration range, market integration).

prereqAssessment.why: The lateen is a rig variant; sailing practice comes first.

nodes.name: Mortise-and-tenon hull
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; large seagoing cargo hulls.

prereqAssessment.why: Edge-joined mortise-and-tenon planking is a plank-boat construction method.

nodes.name: Pharmacopoeia
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. No longer a leaf: the new quinine node takes it as a prerequisite.

prereqAssessment.why: A catalogue of drugs and their effects is a clinical-medicine product.

nodes.effectRationale: A transmissible materia medica raises what taught physicians can do. Live: building.hospital (with clinical medicine).

nodes.name: Surgical instrument set
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate leaf for now. inst.military_medicine requires it, but institutions are not live.

prereqAssessment.why: Surgery as clinical practice.
Bronze instruments; iron blades are not separately required.

nodes.effectRationale: Trauma and cataract surgery with proper instruments save lives and sight.

nodes.name: Abacus
nodes.auditRationale: Replace chinese_script with counting_rods: the Chinese route then passes through the rod arithmetic the abacus actually mechanised. A deliberate leaf: an end-user computing aid.

prereqAssessment.why: Counting boards encode place value (the Salamis board).
The suanpan descends from rod calculation on counting boards, not from the script; counting_rods (A5, ~400 BCE) is the real Chinese antecedent.

nodes.effectRationale: Merchants reckon prices and exchanges fast without literacy, so markets settle quicker.

nodes.name: Alchemy
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Furnace work and the transmutation of metals are alchemy's starting practice.
Theory transmitted in texts (Ge Hong).
Theory transmitted in Greek texts (Zosimos).

nodes.effectRationale: Recipes for parting and refining metals (Leiden and Stockholm papyri) recover more metal from what miners dig.

nodes.name: Distillation
nodes.auditRationale: Kept; five dependents.

prereqAssessment.why: The alembic is an alchemical apparatus (Maria, Zosimos).
Glass still.
Metal still (OR).

nodes.effectRationale: Distilled waters and, later, alcohol give physicians antiseptic washes and concentrated remedies.

nodes.name: Heavy wheeled plough
nodes.auditRationale: Route the iron requirement through the new A4 iron farm-tool node (forged shares, coulters); iron_bloomery remains an indirect prerequisite, so no capability is lost, and the A4 node stops being a leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: Plough and traction lineage.
The iron share and coulter are forged farm ironwork; the new node iron_farm_tools (which itself requires iron_bloomery) is the exact capability.
The wheeled forecarriage the node is named for.

nodes.name: Padded horse collar
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: The padded collar develops from the breast-strap harness.

nodes.name: Nailed horseshoe
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; a terminal practical improvement; sprung_coach (new) now builds on it.

prereqAssessment.why: Nailed shoes are forged iron.
Shoes are for horses.

nodes.name: Early-ripening rice
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Varietal improvement of paddy rice.

nodes.name: Sugar crystallisation
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Sugarcane is vegetatively propagated from New Guinea vegeculture (Kuk); the atom stands for clonal cultivation.
Boiling and crystallising moulds were pottery.

nodes.name: Vertical-axis windmill
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisite correct. Deliberate leaf: the Persian type is a regional branch independent of the European post mill. Live unlock shared with windmill_post, so a distinct operand effect distinguishes the two.

prereqAssessment.why: The panemone drives the same millstone arrangement as the horizontal water mill.

nodes.effectRationale: Sistan windmills ground grain and lifted water for gardens (al-Mas'udi, al-Istakhri): wind-lifted irrigation raises yields in arid land.

nodes.name: Post mill
nodes.auditRationale: Add gearing: the post mill is defined by its right-angle drive, and water_mill does not imply gearing in this graph (its anchor is the gearless horizontal mill). gearing is A5 (~150 BCE), well before 1,180 CE.

prereqAssessment.why: Millstone, spindle and miller's craft come from the water mill.
Sail cloth and rigging on the sweeps; the mill's sails are a land use of sailmaking.
PROPOSED ADDITION: a horizontal-axis rotor must turn a vertical stone spindle through a right-angle gear (brake wheel and wallower); gear trains (~150 BCE) are the real enabling knowledge.

nodes.effectRationale: Milling without a river head spreads mechanical grinding to flat, riverless farmland, releasing household labour where water mills cannot be built.

nodes.name: Fulling mill

future.system: Production chains - fulling mill (deferred-entity plan, tier D)
future.description: water-powered hammers finish cloth at scale

nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND. The live building is the node's effect.

prereqAssessment.why: Fulling stocks are cam-driven water hammers.
There must be woven woollen cloth to full.

nodes.name: Spinning wheel
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND.

prereqAssessment.why: The wheel drives a spindle.
A wheel on an axle, belt-driven.

nodes.name: Horizontal treadle loom
nodes.auditRationale: Correct.

prereqAssessment.why: The treadle loom develops the upright loom.

nodes.name: Roller cotton gin
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND.

prereqAssessment.why: Rollers turned by a crank wheel.
There must be cotton to gin.

nodes.name: Magnetic compass
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; landmark-scale delta because exploreStepNodes is an integer of base 3 and moves only when Σ crosses 0.34.

prereqAssessment.why: A magnetised iron needle needs iron; lodestone knowledge is implicit.

nodes.name: Stern-post rudder
nodes.auditRationale: OR is redundant but not wrong; no change.

prereqAssessment.why: Redundant: mortise_hull itself requires plank_boat, so the OR reduces to plank_boat. Harmless.
The stern-post rudder hangs on a plank hull; Han river boats had no mortise-and-tenon shell.

nodes.name: Watertight bulkheads
nodes.auditRationale: Kept as is; the prerequisite is weak but chain-preserving.

prereqAssessment.why: Weak causally (bulkheads are a hull technique), but it carries the Chinese junk lineage and keeps ocean_junk requiring a rudder; replacing it would need a compensating edge.

nodes.name: Portolan chart
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; differs from compass (step) by acting on range.

prereqAssessment.why: Portolan rhumb lines are compass bearings.
Scaled charting.

nodes.name: Astrolabe
nodes.auditRationale: Kept. Live: an OR path to building.observatory.

prereqAssessment.why: Stereographic projection of the celestial sphere (Hipparchus, Ptolemy).

nodes.effectRationale: Latitude from a star's altitude lets an expedition fix and retrace its position: the explore cap rises one lattice step (15 to 16).

nodes.name: Cog
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; bulk carrier of the Hanseatic trade.

prereqAssessment.why: The cog is the first northern ship with a stern rudder.
Redundant through stern_rudder; harmless.

nodes.name: Gunpowder
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Found by Daoist alchemists seeking elixirs.

nodes.effectRationale: Fire lances, bombs and incendiaries let small garrisons hold distant walls (Song frontier). Military use waits for M7/M8 units.

nodes.name: Saltpetre refining
nodes.auditRationale: Kept; three dependents (cannon, corned powder, sulphuric acid).

prereqAssessment.why: Large-scale refining was driven by demand for high-nitrate powder.

nodes.effectRationale: Refined nitre cures meat and fish that keep through lean seasons.

nodes.name: Early cannon
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. OR between bronze casting and wrought iron is historically right (both barrel types existed).

prereqAssessment.why: Gunpowder rich enough to propel needs refined saltpetre.
Bronze barrels are closed castings (OR branch).
Wrought-iron hooped barrels (OR branch).

nodes.effectRationale: Even weak guns let a ruler batter down a rebel's gate: the reach of central authority extends.

nodes.name: Counterweight trebuchet
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: The counterweight replaces the hauling crew.

nodes.effectRationale: Castles of magnates fall to the crown's engines, so dues long withheld behind walls are collected.

nodes.name: Longbow
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: The longbow is a self bow scaled up; no other requirement is binding.

nodes.effectRationale: Archery is practised by law in every parish and well paid in war; trained commoners rise into the yeomanry.

nodes.name: Plate armour
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: Hardened, tempered steel plates.
Plates are hammered sheet.

nodes.effectRationale: A few armoured men-at-arms can put down a peasant rising (Jacquerie 1358): unrest is suppressed at less cost in output.

nodes.name: Greek fire
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate leaf: a lost state secret with no successor.

prereqAssessment.why: A distilled petroleum fraction is the most accepted reconstruction.

nodes.effectRationale: A fleet armed with a feared incendiary holds sea lanes against raiders, lowering the cost of sea haulage.

nodes.name: Woodblock printing
nodes.auditRationale: Correct prerequisites. Effect is the diffusion of farm technique by print, its best-documented economic use in Song China.

prereqAssessment.why: Block printing needs a cheap absorbent sheet; it took off only on paper.
Carved relief impressed in ink is the seal principle at page scale; Chinese seals and rubbings are the direct precursor.

nodes.name: Ceramic movable type
nodes.auditRationale: Correct derivation. Historically limited by character count, so its effect is small.

prereqAssessment.why: Bi Sheng's type is an extension of block printing: same paper, ink and rubbing, with the block split into reusable characters.
The type is baked clay; firing clay to hardness is the material step.

nodes.name: Metal movable type
nodes.auditRationale: Correct prerequisites. Deliberate leaf: European type founding was independent, so no edge to printing_press is justified.

prereqAssessment.why: Goryeo metal type extends the movable-type principle to cast bronze.
Type is cast in closed moulds (sand moulds in Korea); closed-mould casting is the metal technique.

nodes.name: Paper money
nodes.auditRationale: Correct prerequisites. inst.central_bank is not live, so an operand carries it; the documented effect is monetary liquidity.

prereqAssessment.why: Jiaozi and later notes were block-printed with multiple colour plates to resist forgery.
Notes began as receipts for deposited coin; a coin standard is what they promised.

nodes.name: Hindu-Arabic numerals
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Brahmi numerals are the ancestors of the nine digits.

nodes.effectRationale: Decimal place value with zero makes all written calculation cheap: landmark, more research per person.

nodes.name: Algebra
nodes.auditRationale: Kept. Live: the other OR path to building.university.

prereqAssessment.why: Equations need a positional notation (Brahmagupta, al-Khwarizmi).
Chinese tian yuan algebra works on the counting board (OR).
Completing the square is proved geometrically.

nodes.effectRationale: Half of al-Khwarizmi's book solves inheritance division: shares computed by rule rather than fought over.

nodes.name: Trigonometry
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Chord tables were built for Ptolemaic astronomy.
Sine tables in decimal (Aryabhata).
Or in sexagesimal (Ptolemy).

nodes.effectRationale: Heights and distances computed from a baseline (al-Biruni) let land beyond pacing range be measured and organised: a slightly wider hinterland.

nodes.name: Experimental optics
nodes.auditRationale: Kept. effectsNow deferred: inst.scientific_society is not live yet.

prereqAssessment.why: Ray optics is geometrical.
Glass spheres, lenses and vessels for experiments.

nodes.effectRationale: An experimental method stated as a procedure lets claims be checked by test instead of authority: research costs less.

nodes.name: Spectacles
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Theory of refraction and lenses.
Clear glass for grinding lenses.

nodes.effectRationale: Reading glasses add decades to the working life of every literate scholar and craftsman.

nodes.name: Crank and connecting rod
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND.

prereqAssessment.why: Mill gear trains feed the crank.
Water power drives the first crank-and-rod sawmills (Hierapolis).

nodes.name: Verge escapement
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND.

prereqAssessment.why: A clock is a gear train.
The regulated timekeeping tradition the escapement mechanises.

nodes.name: Water-powered blast furnace
nodes.auditRationale: Replace crank_connecting_rod with trip_hammer (A5, ~40 BCE; prereq water_mill): water power with cams is the mechanism the node is named for, and the crank (general ~1,400) postdates the node's earliest date (~1,150).

prereqAssessment.why: The bellows themselves.
Lapphyttan (~1,150 CE) and medieval furnaces drove their bellows with cams on a waterwheel shaft; the crank became general only ~1,400 CE. trip_hammer is the tree's cam-driven water-power node.
Iron smelting.

nodes.effectRationale: Water-driven bellows make cast iron in quantity in Europe: iron plentiful enough for fully ironed tools.

nodes.name: Wire drawing
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Water-powered drawing (~1,350) used a crank to work the tongs.
Iron feedstock and dies.

nodes.effectRationale: Drawn wire supports dedicated pin, needle, card and mail trades: a larger urban artisan class.

nodes.name: Pound lock
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND.

prereqAssessment.why: Locks are built on dug canals.
Mitre and guillotine lock gates are framed timber.

nodes.name: Double-entry bookkeeping
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites exact. It is a leaf, but its capability ('banking next') points to central_banking and joint_stock (civics, other group). Routed as a finding, not applied here.

prereqAssessment.why: Ledger columns need positional numerals.
Cheap ledgers.
The merchant-banking networks that kept these accounts.

nodes.effectRationale: Audited inventories and capital accounts let merchant houses turn stock over to market faster.

nodes.name: Bill of exchange
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites correct; the OR on literacy preserves the Islamic/Italian and Chinese routes.

prereqAssessment.why: A bill promises payment in a named coin elsewhere; it presupposes coin standards to convert between.
Alphabetic commercial literacy (Arabic suftaja, Italian merchant hands) is the medium of the instrument.
The Tang 'flying money' (feiqian, ~800 CE) is the East Asian draft; the OR keeps that independent route.

nodes.name: Printing press
nodes.auditRationale: All three causal components are present. Landmark node with two moderated research effects (research-coefficient caps are tight, see findings).

prereqAssessment.why: The adjustable hand mould and type-metal alloy are the core of Gutenberg's system.
The screw press (wine and oil presses) is the press mechanism.
Cheap paper made press runs economic; vellum copies were the exception.

nodes.name: Type founding
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. The A3-to-A7 gap is large, but nothing between them is causally required (punch-cutting is goldsmith work, outside the tree).

prereqAssessment.why: Type is cast in a closed hand mould.

nodes.name: Caravel
nodes.auditRationale: Correct prerequisites; live ocean_shipping unlock plus landmark exploration step.

prereqAssessment.why: Lateen rig lets the caravel beat home against the trades.
Required for a seagoing hull of this size.
Open-ocean navigation.

nodes.name: Carrack and full-rigged ship
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; live unlocks plus bulk capacity.

prereqAssessment.why: The carrack takes the cog's rig and rudder onto a frame-first hull.
Lateen mizzen.
Ocean navigation.

nodes.name: Polynesian voyaging canoe
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; the effect is founding-party size, unique in the lane.

prereqAssessment.why: Voyaging hulls are dugout bases with sewn strakes.
Star-path wayfinding.

nodes.name: Celestial navigation with instruments
nodes.auditRationale: Correct.

prereqAssessment.why: Mariner's astrolabe and quadrant measure altitude at sea.
Declination tables and reduction of sights.

nodes.name: Longitude by chronometer
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; a terminal navigation achievement.

prereqAssessment.why: Longitude by chronometer completes the celestial fix.
Harrison's H4 used a verge escapement.

nodes.name: Mercator projection
nodes.auditRationale: Kept; overlaps portolan and celestial_navigation in capability, so the effect is deliberately placed on a different operand.

prereqAssessment.why: Redundant through portolan; harmless.
Rhumb-line charting.
The projection is a trigonometric construction.

nodes.name: Corned gunpowder
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Consistent granules need refined nitre.

nodes.effectRationale: Reliable granulated powder makes blasting in mines possible (Banska Stiavnica, 1627).

nodes.name: Cast bronze cannon
nodes.auditRationale: Keep; landmark of the gunpowder state, slightly larger delta.

prereqAssessment.why: Scales up the gun.
One-piece casting; it is redundant only on cannon_early's bronze branch, so it is kept.

nodes.effectRationale: Siege trains end the castle as a refuge (Constantinople 1453, French Italy 1494): central authority reaches much further.

nodes.name: Cast iron cannon
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Iron guns follow the bronze designs.
Cast iron in gun-sized quantity needs the blast furnace.

nodes.effectRationale: Iron guns at a quarter the price arm ordinary merchantmen, which then sail without escort: cheaper bulk haulage by sea.

nodes.name: Matchlock arquebus
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: The hand gun descends from the cannon.
Corned powder makes small arms reliable.

nodes.effectRationale: Gunpowder infantry is the military revolution that builds the fiscal-military state: armies paid by taxes collect taxes.

nodes.name: Wheellock
nodes.auditRationale: Keep; bridge from matchlock to flintlock.

prereqAssessment.why: A new ignition on the same gun.
Spring-driven wheel from clockwork.

nodes.effectRationale: Pistols for mounted patrols: highway robbery is policed, so roads are travelled faster and disorder costs less.

nodes.name: Flintlock
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Snaphance and flintlock simplify the wheellock's self-ignition.

nodes.effectRationale: A cheap, reliable musket in every settler's hands lets founding parties strike out larger and further (colonial frontiers).

nodes.name: Bastion fort

future.system: Battle Layer - siege and fortification
future.description: low, thick, angled bastions resist cannon and lengthen sieges

nodes.auditRationale: Keep. Live entity unlock is its real effect.

prereqAssessment.why: It is the answer to the bronze gun.
Bastion traces are designed by geometry.
Masonry revetment of the earthworks.

nodes.effectRationale: Live unlock: building.bastion_fort requires it.

nodes.name: Ship of the line
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: The heavy frame-first hull.
Dozens of guns per ship need cheap iron guns.

nodes.effectRationale: Sea control keeps convoy routes open in war, so distant markets stay connected and price gaps close.

nodes.name: Heliocentric model
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Copernicus reworked Ptolemy's models.
Spherical trigonometry for computation (Regiomontanus).

nodes.effectRationale: The Copernican debate reorders natural philosophy and print culture: more civic and cultural output per person.

nodes.name: Telescope
nodes.auditRationale: Kept. Live: an OR path to building.observatory. Naval reconnaissance waits for M7/M8.

prereqAssessment.why: Lens grinding for spectacles produced the first telescopes.

nodes.effectRationale: Spyglasses spot coasts, passes and smoke from far off: the explore cap rises one more step.

nodes.name: Microscope
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Same lens craft.

nodes.effectRationale: Microscopic anatomy in medical faculties (Malpighi's capillaries, 1661) improves university medicine.

nodes.name: Classical mechanics
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Kepler's laws are what Newton derived.
Implied by calculus; a harmless redundancy kept for readability.
Fluxions are the Principia's method, even where it is presented geometrically.

nodes.effectRationale: Prediction from equations replaces trial and error: engineering research is cheaper wherever universities teach it.

nodes.name: Calculus
nodes.auditRationale: Kept. effectsNow deferred: inst.statistics_vital is not live.

prereqAssessment.why: Symbolic manipulation.
Tangents and areas (Archimedes' method of exhaustion).

nodes.effectRationale: Rates and accumulation become computable: the general tool of physics and engineering (landmark).

nodes.name: Barometer and air pump
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Torricelli's tube and Boyle's receiver are glass.
Hydrostatics: the mercury column balances the weight of the air.

nodes.effectRationale: The weather-glass warns of rain and storms at hay and harvest time.

nodes.name: Atmospheric steam engine
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites sound and minimal. Its date (1712) fits A7. coal_fuel (new) is not made a prerequisite: the invention needed vacuum physics and casting, not coal.

prereqAssessment.why: Newcomen's engine works by atmospheric pressure against a condensed-steam vacuum (Torricelli, Guericke, Papin).
Large cylinders and pipework; Coalbrookdale cast Newcomen cylinders from 1718.

nodes.effectRationale: Mine drainage: engines kept coal and tin mines working below the water table, a step change in extraction. Larger delta as the first heat engine.

nodes.name: Coke smelting
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Coke replaces charcoal in an existing blast furnace.

nodes.effectRationale: Iron freed from charcoal and forests: cheap cast iron replaces worn tools, and coal-fed furnaces raise output per worker.

nodes.name: Brass by cementation
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. Becomes the zinc-metallurgy predecessor of the new galvanized_iron node.

prereqAssessment.why: Cementation alloys copper with zinc vapour from calamine.

nodes.effectRationale: Roman orichalcum token coinage eases small exchange; brass is later the instrument metal.

nodes.name: Variolation
nodes.auditRationale: Keep; leads to vaccination.

prereqAssessment.why: Deliberate infection as treatment is a clinical practice.

nodes.effectRationale: Variolation cut smallpox mortality from about 30% to 1-2% in those treated.

nodes.name: Systematic anatomy
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Galenic medicine is what Vesalius corrected.
The Fabrica's illustrations needed accurate print.

nodes.effectRationale: Accurate anatomy taught in university theatres makes surgery and diagnosis safer.

nodes.name: Four-course rotation
nodes.auditRationale: Bridge through the new A6 rotation node; ~800 CE predates ~1,650 CE.

prereqAssessment.why: Clover in the course; also implied by three_field_rotation.
Wheat and barley courses.
ADDED: the four-course system replaces the fallow year of the open-field rotation with turnips and clover; it is an elaboration of a rotation regime, not a direct leap from Neolithic crops.

nodes.name: Horse-drawn seed drill (Europe)
nodes.auditRationale: Keep; the OR captures transmission versus reinvention.

prereqAssessment.why: Transmission route.
Independent European route.
Horse-drawn.

nodes.name: Systematic livestock breeding
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Winter fodder made year-round controlled breeding possible.
Bakewell's Leicester sheep.
Longhorn cattle.

nodes.name: Columbian crop exchange
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Ocean crossing carries the crops.
Maize route.
Potato, cassava, sweet potato route.

nodes.name: Lead crystal
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Ravenscroft's glass was blown.

nodes.effectRationale: Clear, refractive lead glass for lenses and instrument optics.

nodes.name: Navigation canal
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND. Deliberate leaf; the live canal is its main effect.

prereqAssessment.why: Summit-level freight canals need flights of locks.
Route and summit levels are surveyed.

nodes.name: Separate condenser
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites kept (one is redundant but explanatory). Effect continues the mining role at a smaller delta than the first engine.

prereqAssessment.why: Watt improved a Newcomen model engine; the condenser is a modification of that engine.
Redundant through steam_atmospheric, but harmless; it documents the vacuum principle the condenser exploits.

nodes.effectRationale: Quartered fuel use made pumping engines economic at metal mines away from coalfields (Cornish tin and copper).

nodes.name: Precision cylinder boring
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND (cross-lane to military).

prereqAssessment.why: Wilkinson's boring mill was a cannon-boring machine.
The boring bar was water-driven.

nodes.name: Rotary steam engine
nodes.auditRationale: All three atoms are historically necessary. It is the Age VIII milestone fact (ages.json a8_steam).

prereqAssessment.why: Rotary Watt engines were condensing engines.
Wilkinson's 1774 boring mill made Watt's cylinders tight enough to work.
Converting reciprocation to rotation (crank, or sun-and-planet gear to evade the crank patent).

nodes.effectRationale: Factory power anywhere: mills leave the rivers and a much larger share of the population can work as non-farm specialists. Landmark node.

nodes.name: High-pressure steam
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites sound. Effect chosen so it does not double-count the transport nodes it gates.

prereqAssessment.why: Trevithick's engines were double-acting rotary engines run at higher pressure.
Wrought-iron boiler plate strong enough for high pressure.

nodes.effectRationale: Compact high-pressure engines became portable engines: steam threshing and farm power (1840s-50s) raised output per farm worker. Transport uses belong to locomotive and steamboat.

nodes.name: Puddling and rolling
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. Cort's first mills were water-powered, but the scale the node claims came with steam rolling (1790s).

prereqAssessment.why: Pig iron feedstock from coke furnaces.
Puddled bar was rolled in steam-driven mills; 'at scale' is the node's capability.

nodes.effectRationale: Wrought iron fifteen times cheaper: iron machinery, implements and fittings everywhere.

nodes.name: Hot blast
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Hot blast improves the coke furnace.

nodes.effectRationale: Preheated blast cuts fuel per ton by two-thirds and makes poor coals and blackband ores workable.

nodes.name: Bessemer converter
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Bulk iron industry and pig refining.

nodes.effectRationale: Landmark: steel in tons; steel rails and hulls cut bulk haulage costs; steelworks unlocked.

nodes.name: Open-hearth steel
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Liquid-steel practice; Martin worked in the Bessemer context.
Regenerative preheating extends the hot-blast principle.

nodes.effectRationale: Controllable quality steel and scrap recycling: durable tools and machinery.

nodes.name: Basic (Gilchrist-Thomas) process
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Thomas-Gilchrist lining is a converter modification.

nodes.effectRationale: The phosphate-rich slag (Thomas meal) was sold as fertilizer: land yields more.

nodes.name: Slide-rest screw-cutting lathe
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND. Its only entity (inst.standard_threads) is not live, so it carries an operand effect.

prereqAssessment.why: Heavy precision boring precedes the slide rest.
Clockmakers' screw-cutting lathes are the other ancestor.

nodes.name: Interchangeable parts
nodes.auditRationale: Add milling_machine: the Harpers Ferry and Springfield achievement (Hall 1820s, North) depended on milling, not only turning. Milling (~1,818) predates the node (~1,820).

prereqAssessment.why: Precision screw-cutting and turning.

nodes.name: Milling machine
nodes.auditRationale: Correct. Gains interchangeable_parts as a dependent under the proposal.

prereqAssessment.why: Lead-screw feeds and precise slides.

nodes.name: Flying shuttle
nodes.auditRationale: Correct.

prereqAssessment.why: Kay's shuttle runs on a broadloom with a batten.

nodes.name: Spinning jenny
nodes.auditRationale: Correct.

prereqAssessment.why: The jenny multiplies the spindles of the wheel.

nodes.name: Water frame
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND.

prereqAssessment.why: Roller spinning develops wheel spinning.
The frame is water-powered.

nodes.name: Spinning mule
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND (Crompton combined the two).

prereqAssessment.why: Carriage spinning from the jenny.
Drafting rollers from the frame.

nodes.name: Power loom
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND/OR.

prereqAssessment.why: Mechanised picking extends the flying shuttle.

Power source; OR is right.

prereqAssessment.why: Composition analysis.
Reflected-light microscopy.

nodes.effectRationale: Reading metal microstructure turns metallurgy into a laboratory science.

nodes.name: Punched-card tabulation
nodes.auditRationale: Correct prerequisites. Missing bridge: punched-card input/output fed early programmable computers (Harvard Mark I, ENIAC); recommend programmable_computer accept it as an OR alternative (engineering-lane owner).

prereqAssessment.why: Punched cards as machine-readable records come from the Jacquard loom.
Hollerith's reader closed electrical circuits through the holes to drive electromagnetic counters: telegraph-era electrical engineering.

nodes.name: Sanitary engineering
nodes.auditRationale: Correct AND. Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: Steam pumping drives water supply and sewage lifting.
Brick egg-section sewers.

nodes.name: Structural iron
nodes.auditRationale: Correct single prerequisite.

prereqAssessment.why: Coke smelting gave the cheap iron for the Iron Bridge and iron-framed mills.

nodes.name: Water turbine
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites sound.

prereqAssessment.why: Hydraulic power tradition.
Euler's turbine equation; Fourneyron's design is engineered from theory.

nodes.effectRationale: Turbine-driven sawmills (Lowell-era New England) cut boards with thin kerfs instead of hewing: less timber per dwelling (balloon frame era).

nodes.name: Cell theory
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Cells are seen through it.

nodes.effectRationale: Cellular pathology (Virchow) lets university medicine find disease where it starts.

nodes.name: Electromagnetic field theory
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Maxwell unified Faraday's field results.

nodes.effectRationale: Maxwell's Treatise (1873) and the Cavendish Laboratory (1874) make mathematical physics a taught laboratory discipline.

nodes.name: Organic chemistry
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Combustion analysis of carbon compounds.

nodes.effectRationale: Food analysis (adulteration detected in the 1850s) and Liebig's infant food (1865) protect children better in shortages.

nodes.name: Periodic system of the elements
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Atomic weights and element lists.

nodes.effectRationale: Mendeleev devised it while writing a textbook (Principles of Chemistry): chemistry becomes teachable as one ordered system.

nodes.name: Spectroscopy
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Fraunhofer saw his lines through a telescope-and-prism instrument.
Spectral analysis identifies elements.

nodes.effectRationale: Spectroscopic control of the Bessemer blow (Roscoe, 1863) gives consistent steel, so tools wear more slowly.

nodes.name: Stratigraphy and geological mapping
nodes.auditRationale: Kept. The A3 atom surveying is a legitimate long-lived foundation, not a reason to change the edge.

prereqAssessment.why: Rock identification.
The map base.

nodes.effectRationale: Geological maps show which nearby formations hold coal, ore or water: a settlement draws on a wider hinterland.

nodes.name: Thermodynamics
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Carnot analysed the steam engine.
Mathematical form.

nodes.effectRationale: Efficiency limits guide compound and triple-expansion marine engines: cheaper bulk haulage.

nodes.name: Agricultural chemistry
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Plant nutrition is quantitative chemistry.

nodes.name: Chemical fertilizer
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: The theory.
Superphosphate is bone or rock phosphate treated with sulphuric acid.

nodes.name: Horse-drawn farm machinery
nodes.prereq: (heavy_plough OR iron_mouldboard) AND horse_collar AND crank_connecting_rod
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Plough route.
Plough route.
Horse draught.
Reaper and thresher drives.

nodes.name: Fission weapon
nodes.auditRationale: Keep; OR of the two fissile-material routes is correct.

prereqAssessment.why: Little Boy route (OR).
Plutonium route (OR).

nodes.effectRationale: The Manhattan Project left a system of national laboratories and federal research funding for universities.

nodes.name: Guided missile
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Propulsion.
Radar homing and command guidance; the 1943 Hs 293 was radio-commanded, but its radar-homing successors define the node.

nodes.effectRationale: Homing seekers (radar and infrared) are sensors; seeker and tracking technology extends what formations can detect.

nodes.name: Submarine
nodes.prereq: screw_propeller AND iron_hull AND electric_motor AND internal_combustion
nodes.auditRationale: Correct; military role awaits live units (M7/M8).

prereqAssessment.why: Propulsion.
Pressure hull.
Submerged drive.
Surface drive and charging (Holland).

nodes.name: Endocrinology
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Glands as physiology.
Extraction and assay of hormones.

nodes.effectRationale: Insulin makes diabetes survivable; hormone replacement is managed in clinics.

nodes.name: Immunology
nodes.auditRationale: Keep in A9 (its prerequisite vaccine_lab is A9); its own dates (1890/1901) are A8, noted as a finding.

prereqAssessment.why: Serum therapy came from the bacteriology laboratories.

nodes.effectRationale: Diphtheria and tetanus antitoxins saved children above all.

nodes.name: Nuclear medicine
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: Isotopes are its material.

nodes.effectRationale: Tracer diagnosis and radioiodine therapy in hospitals; tracers are also research tools.

nodes.name: Radiation protection
nodes.auditRationale: Keep; three dependents.

prereqAssessment.why: Dosimetry.
The first exposure problem was radiology.

nodes.effectRationale: Dose limits make radiological and nuclear work safe enough to employ at scale.

nodes.name: Radiotherapy
nodes.auditRationale: Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: Radium.
Beam therapy.

nodes.effectRationale: Cancer treatment through radium institutes attached to universities.

nodes.name: Sulfonamides
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Bacterial targets.
Prontosil was a dye.

nodes.effectRationale: First systemic antibacterials: puerperal sepsis and pneumonia, and dysentery in hungry years.

nodes.name: Communications satellite
nodes.auditRationale: Correct prerequisites. Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: A relay satellite is an orbital satellite.
Telstar and Syncom were solar powered.

nodes.name: Fast breeder reactors
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisite correct.

prereqAssessment.why: A breeder fuel cycle needs plutonium separated from spent fuel (nuclear_fission implied).

nodes.effectRationale: A closed fuel cycle makes generation independent of uranium and oil imports: embargoes and strikes cost less output.

nodes.name: Geological waste disposal
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites exact. Deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: Choosing stable formations.
Dose limits and waste classes.
The waste source.

nodes.effectRationale: Isolating long-lived waste from groundwater avoids chronic exposure (small mortality gain), and a credible repository defuses the local siting disputes that waste storage provokes (small grievance relief).

nodes.name: Graphite-moderated reactors
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites sound.

prereqAssessment.why: Chain reaction.
Aluminium-canned fuel slugs at X-10 and Hanford.

nodes.effectRationale: Production piles supplied radioisotope tracers to laboratories (Oak Ridge isotope distribution from 1946): cheaper research in biology and chemistry.

nodes.name: Heavy-water reactors
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites sound.

prereqAssessment.why: Chain reaction.
Pressurised coolant circuits of power variants.

nodes.effectRationale: NRX at Chalk River made the cobalt-60 for the first teletherapy units (1951): university hospitals treat cancer more effectively.

nodes.name: Light-water reactors
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites exact.

prereqAssessment.why: Chain reaction.
Light water needs enriched fuel.
Pressurised and boiling-water circuits.

nodes.effectRationale: The standard civil reactor made large blocks of cheap baseload power available to industry: a larger specialist workforce is sustainable.

nodes.name: Orbital launch vehicle
nodes.auditRationale: Correct.

prereqAssessment.why: Rocket lineage.

nodes.name: Programmable digital computer
nodes.auditRationale: The OR is right (independent valve and relay routes).

prereqAssessment.why: Colossus and ENIAC route.
Zuse's relay route.
The numerical analysis the machines were built for (ballistic tables).

nodes.effectRationale: Colossus broke Lorenz traffic and revealed German dispositions before D-Day; ENIAC and Z3 automated scientific calculation.

nodes.name: Voice radio and broadcasting
nodes.auditRationale: Correct prerequisites. The broadcast institution is not live; the operand is unrest management, its documented political use.

prereqAssessment.why: Broadcasting is radio transmission to many receivers.
Voice modulation and amplification need valves (de Forest, Armstrong).

nodes.name: Spent-fuel reprocessing
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites sound.

prereqAssessment.why: Irradiated fuel.
Remote handling and shielding of hot cells.

nodes.effectRationale: PUREX solvent extraction became general hydrometallurgy (copper SX-EW from 1968, rare-earth separation): more metal from each tonne of ore.

nodes.name: Uranium enrichment
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites sound.

prereqAssessment.why: Isotope physics.
Uranium feed.

nodes.effectRationale: The enrichment complexes (Oak Ridge, Sverdlovsk-44) trained tens of thousands of technicians, a lasting pipeline into skilled classes.

nodes.name: Radioactive ore processing
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites are the knowledge actually needed; keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Knowing what to recover.
Acid leaching of ore.

nodes.effectRationale: Radium recovered from uranium ores supplied the first radiotherapy: university medicine saves more lives.

nodes.name: DNA sequencing
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: The molecule to be read.

nodes.effectRationale: Sequence databases make biological research cheaper; genetic diagnosis in teaching hospitals.

nodes.name: Geophysical prospecting
nodes.auditRationale: Kept; a deliberate leaf (the assay order is the live prospecting mechanic).

prereqAssessment.why: Geological interpretation.
Magnetic and electrical survey methods.

nodes.effectRationale: Concealed ore and oil bodies are located before digging: less dead work per miner, and a wider exploitable hinterland.

nodes.name: Nuclear physics
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Counters.
Theory.
Mass-energy.

nodes.effectRationale: Cyclotrons as university instruments (Lawrence's Radiation Laboratory) make nuclear research cheaper.

nodes.name: Radiation detection and counting
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: What is detected.
Amplified pulse counting.

nodes.effectRationale: Diagnostic counting in hospitals; film badges protect radiation workers.

nodes.name: Radioactivity and radiochemistry
nodes.auditRationale: Move A9 to A8 by its own dates (1896-1898, wholly before 1914). Both prerequisites are A8 and all four dependents are A9, so no edge breaks and nothing is blocked by the Age sweep.

prereqAssessment.why: Becquerel found it on photographic plates.
Electrometer measurement (the Curies).

nodes.effectRationale: Radium therapy in university hospitals (from ~1904), and radioactive tracers (Hevesy, 1913) for research.

nodes.name: Radioisotope production
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Irradiation.
Safe handling.

nodes.effectRationale: Co-60-sterilised flies eradicate screwworm (US, 1959-1966): more output per herder. Irradiation also disinfests stored grain.

nodes.name: Radiometric prospecting
nodes.auditRationale: Kept; a deliberate leaf.

prereqAssessment.why: Instruments.
Host formations.

nodes.effectRationale: Car-borne and airborne surveys map resources across a wider hinterland.

nodes.name: Semiconductor physics
nodes.auditRationale: Kept.

prereqAssessment.why: Band theory.
Crystal detectors were the first semiconductor devices.

nodes.effectRationale: Industrial solid-state research (Bell Labs) employs physicists and engineers: a larger specialist class.

nodes.name: Scientific plant breeding
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Mendelian crosses.

nodes.name: Herbal remedies
nodes.auditRationale: fire_making: infusions, decoctions and fumigation need fire; the hearth is where plant preparations are made. Dated far earlier than the node.
nodes.effectRationale: Willow and poplar bark for pain, anthelmintic fungi and wound dressings slightly lower everyday mortality.

nodes.name: Purpose-built granaries
nodes.auditRationale: Only cultivated grain is stored in bulk; Dhra' granaries belong to the earliest cultivators.

nodes.name: Masonry dam and reservoir
nodes.auditRationale: A dam is fitted stone and earth fill across a wadi (stone_dry); impounded water is only worth holding once fields are fed by channels (irrigation_canal). Both are A2 and centuries older than Jawa.

nodes.name: Signal beacons
nodes.auditRationale: fire_making: a beacon is a prepared fire. stone_dry: posts are towers and cairns on heights. Both far older than the node.
nodes.effectRationale: Warnings and simple orders cross a province in hours, so the centre can respond at distance: administrative reach extends.

nodes.name: Iron farm tools
nodes.auditRationale: Forged bloomery iron applied to the two existing hand tools of tillage and harvest.

nodes.name: Lifting crane
nodes.auditRationale: cordage: hoisting ropes. wheel_solid: the axle-and-drum winch (windlass) is the crane's drive. ashlar_masonry: dressed blocks with lewis holes are what cranes were built to lift. All dated millennia before the node.
nodes.effectRationale: Cranes replace earthen ramps and large hauling crews: buildings take less labour.

nodes.name: Desert caravan
nodes.auditRationale: The dromedary (camel, ~1,000 BCE; Bactrian ~2,500 BCE) is the carrier that can go days without water; organised caravans presuppose exchange between communities at a counted standard (trade, ~3,500 BCE). Both A3 and older than the node.

nodes.name: Parchment codex
nodes.auditRationale: Parchment is limed, scraped and stretched animal skin, a hide-working craft (hide_working, ~100 kya). The codex is the alphabetic literate world's book (abjad, ~1,800 BCE): Greek, Latin, Syriac and Hebrew scriptures and law. Both are older and from earlier Ages.

nodes.name: Multi-storey apartment block
nodes.auditRationale: Insulae stand on brick-faced pozzolan concrete walls; concrete (~300 BCE) and fired brick (~2,900 BCE) both predate the first recorded blocks.

nodes.name: Herring buss and sea-curing
nodes.auditRationale: A decked, seaworthy hull for weeks at sea (cog) and salt to cure the catch aboard (salt_extraction).

nodes.name: Three-field rotation
nodes.auditRationale: The spring course is legumes and oats; open-field strips are ploughed. A heavy_plough link is often argued but contested, so it is not required.

nodes.name: Coal as fuel
nodes.auditRationale: mining_shaft: coal is won from pits and bell-pit shafts. bellows: coal burns well only under forced draught in forges and furnaces. Both dated far earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Shipped coal frees a city from its firewood belt (London and Newcastle sea-coal), and a coal miner wins far more heat per year than a woodcutter.

nodes.name: Tinplate
nodes.auditRationale: iron_bloomery: the base metal is iron sheet. sheet_metal: hammering metal to thin sheet, and (through tin_bronze) knowledge of tin as a metal. trip_hammer: water-driven tilt hammers beat the iron to sheet in the Bohemian and Saxon works. All dated well before the node.

nodes.name: Mine pumping engines
nodes.auditRationale: water_mill: the water wheel drives the pumps. crank_connecting_rod: turns rotation into the reciprocating stroke of rod pumps. mining_shaft: the shafts being drained. All dated earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Drained shafts reach ore below the water table: each extractor works richer, deeper ground.

nodes.name: Sustained-yield forestry
nodes.auditRationale: Managed forests presuppose legal reserves and rights of cutting (forest_law, civic, ~1,079 CE). Cutting only the annual growth needs stands divided into measured compartments (surveying, ~2,500 BCE). Both are older and from earlier Ages.

nodes.name: Crucible cast steel
nodes.auditRationale: coke: a coke-fired draught furnace is what reaches the ~1,600 C needed to melt steel (coke 1709 CE precedes). steel_carburized: the charge is cementation (blister) steel, the tree's carburized-steel node.

nodes.name: Antiscorbutics
nodes.auditRationale: medicine_hippocratic: Lind's comparative trial is clinical observation. carrack: months-long ocean voyages created mass scurvy. Both centuries older.
nodes.effectRationale: Crews and emigrants survive months at sea, so migrants travel further and voyages of exploration range wider.

nodes.name: Electrostatics and the lightning rod
nodes.auditRationale: barometer_vacuum (1643 CE): Hauksbee's glass-globe friction machine came out of air-pump work, and the Leyden jar is glasswork from the same laboratories.
nodes.effectRationale: Lightning rods stop strike fires: buildings last longer.

nodes.name: Logarithms
nodes.auditRationale: hindu_arabic: Briggs' tables are decimal. trigonometry: Napier built logarithms to shorten sine products in astronomy and navigation. Both are dated centuries before 1614.
nodes.effectRationale: Quick dead-reckoning and position computation at sea mean shorter, safer voyages: cheaper bulk haulage.

nodes.name: Sprung coach and stage service
nodes.auditRationale: A light passenger vehicle on spoked wheels (wheel_spoked) drawn by shod teams changed at stages (horseshoe, ~900 CE); steel leaf springs need carburized steel (steel_carburized). All three are dated before ~1,450 CE.

nodes.name: Steam-powered printing press
nodes.auditRationale: The machine mechanises Gutenberg's process (printing_press, ~1,450 CE). It is driven by rotary steam power (steam_rotary, 1781 CE). Both are older and from earlier Ages.

nodes.name: Balloon framing
nodes.auditRationale: It is light timber framing (timber_frame) made from standard sawn studs, which need powered crank-and-rod sawmills (crank_connecting_rod); both long predate 1832.

nodes.name: Coal-gas lighting
nodes.auditRationale: coke: gas is made by carbonising coal in closed retorts, the coke-making process. chemistry_quantitative (1789): gas purification and the chemistry of combustible gases. Both dated before 1792.
nodes.effectRationale: Gas-lit streets, reading rooms, mechanics' institutes and theatres moved civic and cultural life into the evening.

nodes.name: Galvanized corrugated iron
nodes.auditRationale: puddling: cheap wrought iron rolled to sheet (1784 CE precedes). brass_calamine: the tree's only zinc-metallurgy node (zinc ore and zinc vapour); metallic zinc distillation (Champion 1738 CE) has no node, so this is the nearest correct atom.

nodes.name: Quinine
nodes.auditRationale: pharmacology: cinchona bark entered the pharmacopoeias first. chemistry_quantitative (1789): isolating the alkaloid is analytical chemistry. Both predate 1820.
nodes.effectRationale: Founding parties survive malarial country (the West African 'white man's grave'), so larger parties can be sent; endemic malaria deaths fall slightly.

nodes.name: Metric system
nodes.auditRationale: standard_weights: the older state measure it replaces. trigonometry: the metre came from the Delambre-Mechain meridian triangulation. chemistry_quantitative (1789 CE): the kilogram was defined by a mass of water, and Lavoisier sat on the commission. All are dated before 1795.
nodes.effectRationale: Common decimal units remove conversion and disputes between markets, so trade closes price gaps faster.

nodes.name: Synoptic meteorology
nodes.auditRationale: barometer_vacuum: pressure readings are the observation. telegraph (1837 CE): simultaneous reports from many stations are what make a weather map possible. Both predate 1854.
nodes.effectRationale: Frost and storm warnings save crops at critical moments and keep ships in port through gales.

nodes.name: Industrialised panel building
nodes.auditRationale: Factory-cast reinforced concrete panels (reinforced_concrete) are set in place by electric tower cranes (electric_motor); both are A8 and older than 1953.

nodes.name: Aerial reconnaissance
nodes.auditRationale: aircraft (1903 CE): the platform. photography (1839 CE): reconnaissance became systematic with aerial cameras and photo interpretation.
nodes.effectRationale: Aerial photography and survey reveal country far beyond ground parties' reach: exploration range grows.

nodes.name: Written law
nodes.auditRationale: Sound gate with 16 dependents. Any one script suffices (OR is right). emerged is null: suggest '~2,100 BCE Ur-Nammu; ~1,754 BCE Hammurabi'.

prereqAssessment.why: Ur-Nammu (~2,100 BCE) and Hammurabi (~1,754 BCE) wrote their laws in cuneiform.
Egyptian royal decrees and court records are an independent written route to law.
Western Zhou bronze inscriptions record judgments and penalties; a separate route.

nodes.effectRationale: Known rules and fixed penalties replace the ruler's whim: wrongs are settled by rule instead of nursed as grievances. Landmark of the lane, hence 0.04.

nodes.name: Systematic law
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. emerged is null: suggest '~450 BCE Twelve Tables; 529-534 CE Corpus Juris Civilis'; both dates sit after the A4 window, but the node is a long-established A4 gate with the live university behind it, so no Age move is proposed.

prereqAssessment.why: Systematic law organizes, classifies and extends an existing body of written law.

nodes.effectRationale: A systematic law of contract, sale and obligation lets strangers deal on known terms across a realm, so goods move toward higher prices faster. inst.university (library AND legal_code_roman) is live.

nodes.name: Census
nodes.prereq: (cuneiform OR hieroglyphic OR chinese_script) AND appointed_officials
nodes.auditRationale: Replace stamp_seal with appointed_officials (causal: the count is an official act). Age A4 kept. emerged is null: suggest '~3,000 BCE Egyptian biennial count; 2 CE Han census'.

prereqAssessment.why: Counts were written lists; any script serves (OR group).
Egypt's biennial count of cattle and people from the first dynasties is a hieroglyphic record.
Han household counts are written in Chinese script; separate route.

Sealing controls goods; it does not count people. A census is carried out house by house by officials acting on written orders (Egyptian counts, Roman censors, Han registers): replace with appointed_officials. stamp_seal stays in the closure through appointed_officials -> taxation, so nothing earlier is lost.

nodes.effectRationale: Counted households can be assessed: the levy is applied to everyone, not only to those an official happens to know. 0.05 because the census is the fiscal base of the A4 state.

nodes.name: Wage labour in coin
nodes.auditRationale: Runtime anchor (inst.coined_wage, deferred to its owner); feeds mercenary_contracts, labour_unions, cooperatives and the new friendly_societies.

prereqAssessment.why: Wages counted in coin need a coin standard; before coinage, hire was paid in grain or weighed silver (hire_tariffs).

nodes.effectRationale: A wage in coin is portable and spendable anywhere, so labourers can leave the estate that feeds them and follow work.

nodes.name: Patent system
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. It was a leaf; this group adds trademark_law (A8) and patent_cooperation (A9) as successors. emerged is null: suggest '1474 CE Venetian Patent Statute; 1624 CE Statute of Monopolies'.

prereqAssessment.why: A patent is a legal privilege enforced in court against copiers.
Published specifications and printed registers are the disclosure that justifies the monopoly; the system of 1624 onward relies on print, though the 1474 Venetian statute came before print spread.

nodes.effectRationale: Disclosure: a patent publishes how the invention works, so later inventors and university workshops start from it instead of rediscovering it.

nodes.name: Joint-stock company
nodes.auditRationale: Runtime anchor with three dependents; the 1250 CE Bazacle mill company of Toulouse supports the A6 placement.

prereqAssessment.why: Transferable paper claims are the precondition for transferable shares in a common fund.
A company needs corporate personality (societas, universitas) from systematic law to outlive its members.

nodes.effectRationale: Pooled capital pays for larger ships, convoys and warehouses, so each unit of bulk freight costs less to move.

nodes.name: Taxation
nodes.prereq: token_counting AND stamp_seal AND (proto_writing OR hieroglyphic OR chinese_script)
nodes.auditRationale: Live gate (sim.json taxationRequires). Three-part AND with an OR of scripts is right; no change.

prereqAssessment.why: Counted tokens and later tablets record what is owed; the levy is a counted share.
Sealed stores and sealed receipts are how levies were delivered and checked at Uruk.
Uruk IV accounting tablets are the earliest written levy records.
Egyptian harvest assessment is an independent written route.
Shang and Zhou tribute records are a separate route.

nodes.effectRationale: The tax edict (live order) is the effect: a declared levy on the realm's production.

nodes.name: Council of elders
nodes.auditRationale: Root civic of the representation lane; five dependents. Keep.
nodes.effectRationale: Elders' mediation settles quarrels before they become feuds: grievance builds more slowly.

nodes.name: Hereditary rank
nodes.auditRationale: Sound root of the legitimacy lane with six dependents; the OR of the two surplus economies is historically right.

prereqAssessment.why: Stored grain is heritable wealth: inherited rank appears where surplus can be held and passed on.
Herds are the other heritable stock; pastoral societies rank lineages by herd wealth, so the OR is right.

nodes.effectRationale: Lineage heads who hold rank by birth can claim a customary share of harvest and herd as tribute, so a polity extracts more from its output.

nodes.name: Oath alliances
nodes.auditRationale: Runtime A2 diplomacy root; five dependents rely on it. Emerged text dates only the written attestation (~2,400 BCE); the practice is pre-literate.

prereqAssessment.why: An alliance is sworn by the heads who already speak for each community; without a council there is no party able to bind the group.

nodes.effectRationale: Marriage and gift alliances move brides, kin and refugees between allied villages, so people relocate more readily.

nodes.name: Organized priesthood
nodes.auditRationale: Hub node (seven dependents across belief, regimes and arts). Prerequisites are sound.

prereqAssessment.why: Priests are first the keepers of the ritual calendar; Eridu and Uruk temples timed festivals and sowing by it.
A full-time priesthood is fed from temple offerings of grain.
Or from offerings of animals; the OR mirrors hereditary_rank.

nodes.effectRationale: Offerings collected at the shrine are held under ritual protection and handed back in lean seasons, so households absorb small shortfalls.

nodes.name: Chiefdom
nodes.auditRationale: Government form (leaf by rule). Single prerequisite is the defining one.

prereqAssessment.why: A paramount chief is a hereditary office over ranked lineages.

nodes.effectRationale: A paramount chief's authority runs through subordinate village chiefs, so control reaches several villages instead of one.

civ6.analog: Code Of Laws (unlocks the Chiefdom government)

nodes.name: Tribal confederacy
nodes.auditRationale: Government form (leaf). The emerged dates (Xiongnu 209 BCE, Haudenosaunee ~1450 CE) are later than A2, but the capability (a sworn league of tribes) needs only oath_alliance and is plausible for Neolithic tribes; the Age is a capability placement, so it is kept. The emerged text should state that the A2 placement is a capability inference.

prereqAssessment.why: A confederacy is a standing sworn league; oaths among autonomous groups are its precondition.

nodes.effectRationale: Peace sworn among member tribes lets goods move between their territories, closing price gaps faster.

nodes.name: Appointed officials
nodes.prereq: taxation AND (cuneiform OR hieroglyphic OR chinese_script)
nodes.auditRationale: Keep; 21 dependents, a true hub.

prereqAssessment.why: Officials are paid from, and exist to collect and spend, the levy.
Written orders are what make an official removable and accountable; any script (OR).
Old Kingdom officials acted on written royal orders.
Zhou appointment inscriptions record offices conferred in writing.

nodes.effectRationale: Officials carrying written orders project the ruler's authority far from the court. Landmark of administration, hence 0.06.

nodes.name: Corvée labour
nodes.auditRationale: Keep as a deliberate leaf: its successors are conscription and wage labour, which live in other lanes.

prereqAssessment.why: Labour service is the levy taken in work rather than in kind.

nodes.effectRationale: Rotating gangs owed to the state dig canals and build roads: more path-building per worker.

nodes.name: Council of notables
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. Its emerged dates (~700 BCE Sparta, ~500 BCE Rome) fall in A4/A5 while the node is A3; Early Dynastic Mesopotamian city elders are the A3 evidence and should be cited in emerged.

prereqAssessment.why: The council of notables narrows the elders' council to the leading families.
Membership by family standing presupposes inherited rank.

nodes.effectRationale: Binding the great families into decisions keeps their rivalries in the council chamber rather than in armed faction.

nodes.name: Envoys and diplomatic letters
nodes.auditRationale: Writing-gated diplomacy root; feeds sworn_treaties, tributary_relations and missionary_religion.

prereqAssessment.why: Sealed letters carried by accredited envoys need a script; the OR over the three independent scripts is correct.
Sealed letters carried by accredited envoys need a script; the OR over the three independent scripts is correct.
Sealed letters carried by accredited envoys need a script; the OR over the three independent scripts is correct.

nodes.effectRationale: Envoys travel to and report on distant courts and the lands between, widening the range an Explore order can be sent into.

nodes.name: Sacred kingship
nodes.auditRationale: Seven dependents; both conjuncts are required by the definition.

prereqAssessment.why: Sacred kingship is hereditary rank raised to a divine office.
Temple ritual upholds the king; Egyptian and Sumerian kingship rested on priestly rites.

nodes.effectRationale: Dues to a god-sanctioned king are a religious duty; Egyptian and Sumerian kings levied harvest shares through temple and palace, so more output is extracted.

nodes.name: Land held for service
nodes.auditRationale: Runtime anchor with seven dependents (feudal and representative forms).

prereqAssessment.why: Service land is an assessed obligation recorded alongside the levy; the ilku is a fiscal category.
Hammurabi's laws (paras. 26-41) define who holds service land and what is forfeit; tenure needs written law.

nodes.effectRationale: Soldiers settled on granted land hold outlying districts for the crown without a paid garrison, so authority reaches further.

nodes.name: Rules of succession
nodes.auditRationale: Four dependents; sound.

prereqAssessment.why: A succession rule regulates inherited office.
The Proclamation of Telipinu is a written law of succession.

nodes.effectRationale: A fixed rule naming the heir prevents the succession wars that followed royal deaths (the Hittite Old Kingdom before Telipinu), so disorder costs less output.

nodes.name: Sworn treaties
nodes.auditRationale: Hub of the diplomacy lane: five dependents.

prereqAssessment.why: Treaty texts were negotiated and exchanged by envoys (Ebla-Abarsal, Kadesh).
The written treaty formalises the older sworn alliance; the oath before the gods is kept.

nodes.effectRationale: Sworn boundary treaties (Lagash-Umma over the Gu'edena fields) make border land safe to work, so settlements draw on a wider hinterland.

nodes.name: Oligarchic city-state
nodes.auditRationale: Government form (leaf). Emerged cites ~700 BCE, later than A3; Old Assyrian Assur (~1,900 BCE, city assembly and elders ruling a merchant city) supports the A3 placement and should be added to the emerged text. The chronology test is unaffected because elite_council is itself dated ~700 BCE.

prereqAssessment.why: Oligarchy is rule by the council of leading families.
Oligarchic poleis and communes are bounded by written law.

nodes.effectRationale: Merchant-led city councils (Old Assyrian Assur, Italian communes) run the city for trade: courts and tolls favour traffic, so price gaps close faster.

nodes.name: Territorial kingship
nodes.auditRationale: Government form (leaf). The OR-AND is correct.

prereqAssessment.why: Egypt's territorial monarchy was sacral.
Or a legal succession rule (Shang, Hittite). The OR admits both routes.
Ruling many settlements needs appointed officials.

nodes.effectRationale: Royal officials posted to many settlements carry the king's authority across a realm; the largest A3 reach effect, as the first territorial state.

nodes.name: Popular assembly
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. The A1->A4 gap is the real history: the assembly is the council of household heads grown to a community.

prereqAssessment.why: The popular assembly extends the household heads' meeting to all free men of the community.

nodes.effectRationale: Free members who vote on war and law accept outcomes they helped decide.

nodes.name: Elected magistracies
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Magistrates are elected by the assembly.

nodes.effectRationale: Fixed terms and annual rotation stop one man or faction from holding power until it must be taken by force.

nodes.name: Land registry
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. emerged spans 2,500 BCE to 1858 CE; the A4 node is the early register, and the 1858 Torrens title is a later refinement, not a separate node.

prereqAssessment.why: Fields must be measured before they can be registered.
A register is evidence of title only under a law that recognizes it.

nodes.effectRationale: Recorded boundaries and title end boundary disputes and let holders invest in drainage and manuring with confidence.

nodes.name: Provincial governors
nodes.auditRationale: Keep.

prereqAssessment.why: Governors are appointed officials placed over provinces.
A province is administered and assessed through its count of people and land.

nodes.effectRationale: Governors answering to the capital carry its authority to distant provinces. Landmark (satrapies, Assyrian provinces), hence 0.07.

nodes.name: Standing army
nodes.auditRationale: Landmark military node with seven dependents; inst.military_medicine depends on it but that institution is not live (M7/M8), so effects are deferred to operands.

prereqAssessment.why: A paid, supplied permanent force needs officials to muster, pay and ration it; the Akkadian and Assyrian armies were run by the royal administration.

nodes.effectRationale: A permanent force backs the collector and garrisons provinces, so levies are enforced and reach extends.

nodes.name: Tax farming
nodes.auditRationale: Keep as a deliberate leaf: superseded by salaried collection (income_tax path), not a parent of it.

prereqAssessment.why: Tax farming contracts out an existing levy.
Farms were bid for and paid in coin; contractors turned in-kind revenue into money.

nodes.effectRationale: Tax farmers sell the grain and goods they collect to raise the coin they owe: stocks reach markets faster.

nodes.name: Theocratic rule
nodes.auditRationale: Government form (leaf). Prerequisites sound.

prereqAssessment.why: Religious office must exist to hold government.
Rule under religious law needs written law...
...or a sacral monarchy whose priests take over (Thebes under the high priests of Amun).

nodes.effectRationale: Tithes and temple dues collected by the religious hierarchy itself raise the share of output the government extracts.

nodes.name: Craft guilds
nodes.auditRationale: Sound OR of two independent origins; now also feeds apprenticeship and mutual_aid_fraternities.

prereqAssessment.why: Roman craft collegia were licensed associations under systematic law.
Medieval guilds drew their monopoly from the town charter; the OR keeps both historical routes.

nodes.effectRationale: Guild masters enforce standards of temper and finish, so the tools smiths and wrights sell to farmers wear out more slowly.

civ7.analog: Rakuichi-Rakuza (Sengoku Japan unique civic; Kabunakama tradition)

nodes.name: Municipal charters
nodes.auditRationale: Keep; the OR of council or assembly is historically right.

prereqAssessment.why: A charter is written law granted to a town.
Town government by a council of notables is one route (OR).
Town government by an assembly of citizens is the other route (OR).

nodes.effectRationale: A chartered town gets jurisdiction and market rights over its surrounding district, so it draws on a wider hinterland.

nodes.name: Religious toleration
nodes.auditRationale: Prerequisites and Age are right; feeds secular_state.

prereqAssessment.why: Toleration is a legal status (Ashoka's edicts, the Edict of Milan) that needs systematic law to grant and protect it.
Toleration presupposes organised cults whose rival claims the law must arbitrate.

nodes.effectRationale: When minority faiths are protected by law, sectarian disturbances interrupt less work.

nodes.name: Assembly democracy
nodes.auditRationale: Government form (leaf). Athenian democracy used the lot, not elections, so elected_magistracies is rightly absent.

prereqAssessment.why: The assembly is the sovereign body.
Cleisthenes' order is statutory.

nodes.effectRationale: Citizens air grievances and vote on them in the assembly, so grievance builds more slowly.

nodes.name: Bureaucratic empire
nodes.auditRationale: Government form (leaf). Sound.

prereqAssessment.why: Provinces under salaried governors define the form.
A permanent army holds the provinces.

nodes.effectRationale: Salaried officials, provinces and roads keep the centre's orders effective far from the capital: a landmark reach effect (Achaemenid, Qin, Rome).

nodes.name: Mixed-constitution republic
nodes.auditRationale: Government form (leaf). citizen_assembly is implied through elected_magistracies.

prereqAssessment.why: Elected annual magistrates (and through them the citizen assembly) are the popular element.
The senate is the aristocratic element of the mixed constitution.

nodes.effectRationale: Offices open by election let new men rise (the Roman cursus honorum), so promotion between classes is faster.

civ6.analog: Political Philosophy (unlocks the Classical Republic government)

nodes.name: Civil service examinations
nodes.auditRationale: Keep. Now also proposed as the parent of merit_civil_service (see that record).

prereqAssessment.why: Examinations select among candidates for appointed office.
Mass written examinations on the classics depend on cheap paper.

nodes.effectRationale: Office by examination lets talented commoners rise into the official class.

nodes.name: Merchant law
nodes.auditRationale: Hub of the commerce lane with four dependents and the new commenda.
