nodes.effectRationale: A known daily wage lets labourers travel to wherever harvest hands are needed.

nodes.name: Merchant colony courts
nodes.auditRationale: trade: a merchant colony abroad exists for long-distance trade (~3,500 BCE). law_code: its court applies the home city's written law.
nodes.effectRationale: Disputes settled at the trading post, not sent home, mean fewer losses and delays on each caravan.

nodes.name: Judges and court records
nodes.auditRationale: law_code: judges apply written law. appointed_officials: judges are officials named by the ruler (~2,600 BCE), earlier than the first case records (~2,100 BCE).
nodes.effectRationale: Disputes end in a recorded verdict instead of self-help and brawls that stop work.

nodes.name: Campaign supply depots
nodes.auditRationale: appointed_officials: officials stock and issue rations. donkey OR cart: pack and draught transport move the stores.
nodes.effectRationale: Provisioned stations make longer routes usable.

nodes.name: Royal road-houses
nodes.auditRationale: appointed_officials: the stations are staffed and provisioned by officials. donkey: the pack animals they rest and fodder.
nodes.effectRationale: Travellers find water, food and fresh fodder at every stage instead of carrying them, so they cover more ground each day.

nodes.name: Overkingship
nodes.auditRationale: sacral_kingship: the overlord is a sanctioned king. sworn_treaties: vassal kings are bound by treaty oaths (Ebla-Abarsal, ~2,400 BCE, same date).
nodes.effectRationale: Vassal tribute adds to what the overlord extracts without his own officials.

nodes.name: Village and ward heads
nodes.auditRationale: village_headship: the community already has a head (~5,500 BCE). taxation: the state now holds that head responsible for its dues (~3,300 BCE).
nodes.effectRationale: A local head who knows every household collects the levy more completely than an outsider.

nodes.name: Ration distribution
nodes.auditRationale: temple_economy: the institution that feeds its dependants; token_counting: rations are counted and recorded.
nodes.effectRationale: Dependants on the ration lists are fed even in bad years, so fewer die of famine.

nodes.name: Royal storehouses
nodes.auditRationale: provincial_administration: stores are kept province by province (~2,300 BCE onward). royal_archives: every receipt and issue is filed (~2,400 BCE).
nodes.effectRationale: A network of provincial stores holds several years of revenue in kind: granaries hold more.

nodes.name: Ethical religion
nodes.auditRationale: organized_priesthood: the cult the prophets reform. law_code: divine justice is framed as law. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Religious duties of charity and fair dealing, and prophetic rebuke of the powerful, ease the grievances of the poor.

nodes.name: Pilgrimage and sacred truce

future.system: Society - religion and pilgrimage
future.description: pilgrims travel to shared sanctuaries under a sacred truce

nodes.auditRationale: organized_priesthood: sanctuaries are run by priests. track_road: pilgrims travel built routes. Both are much earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Safe passage under the truce and sanctuary hostels on the sacred ways let travellers cover more ground each day.

nodes.name: Private banking houses
nodes.auditRationale: interest_bearing_credit: the loan contract; land_registry: registered land serves as security.
nodes.effectRationale: Advances against harvests let farmers and merchants sell stock without waiting for a buyer to bring silver.

nodes.name: Letter schools
nodes.auditRationale: alphabet_vowels: an easy script children can learn; citizen_assembly: citizens who need to read laws and ostraca.
nodes.effectRationale: Reading spreads beyond a scribal caste, so ordinary families can climb.

nodes.name: Water-turn shares
nodes.auditRationale: qanat: the channel whose flow is shared; water_rights: the legal frame for shares.
nodes.effectRationale: Secure, tradable water shares reward new channels, so more land is watered and yields rise.

nodes.name: State resettlement
nodes.auditRationale: provincial_administration: governors receive and settle the newcomers. standing_army: the army moves them.
nodes.effectRationale: State-organised moves carry people over very long distances.

nodes.name: Weekly rest day
nodes.auditRationale: scriptural_canon: the rest day is a written religious command; hire_tariffs: it protects hired workers.
nodes.effectRationale: A guaranteed rest day removes a constant source of resentment among labourers.

nodes.name: Succession oaths
nodes.auditRationale: succession_law: the heir is named by rule. sworn_treaties: officials and vassals swear treaty oaths to uphold him. Both are A3 and earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Governors sworn personally to the heir keep distant provinces loyal through the change of reign.

nodes.name: Siege and road engineers
nodes.auditRationale: standing_army: engineers are permanent specialists. siege_ram: the siege train they build and move.
nodes.effectRationale: Trained engineers build more path per worker.

nodes.name: Tyranny
nodes.auditRationale: elite_council: tyrants rose from aristocratic faction struggles (~700 BCE). citizen_militia OR standing_army: hoplite backing or a bodyguard/mercenary force.
nodes.effectRationale: Tyrants employed the poor on public works (the Eupalinos tunnel, Peisistratid fountain-houses and roads), so more labour goes into building.

nodes.name: Property classes
nodes.auditRationale: citizen_assembly: the classes sort the members of an assembly (~700 BCE). census: classes are assigned by an assessment of wealth.
nodes.effectRationale: Office by wealth rather than birth lets new families rise: faster promotion.

nodes.name: Palace library
nodes.auditRationale: royal_archives: the library grows from the palace record store, adding copied scholarly works.
nodes.effectRationale: A catalogued collection of the realm's learning lets scholars build on all of it.

nodes.name: Household registers
nodes.auditRationale: census: the register continues the count. provincial_administration: county and provincial officials keep it up to date (~2,300 BCE onward).
nodes.effectRationale: A continuously updated register with mutual responsibility leaves few households off the tax rolls.

nodes.name: Congregations
nodes.auditRationale: scriptural_canon: the congregation gathers to hear the text read. communal_feasts: the common meal of the assembly. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Congregational alms and shared meals keep members alive through dearth.

nodes.name: Hegemonic leagues
nodes.auditRationale: sworn_treaties: the league is sworn. citizen_assembly OR elite_council: member cities decide through their councils.
nodes.effectRationale: League contributions are collected from allies on a fixed assessment.

nodes.name: Sea loans
nodes.auditRationale: banking_houses: lenders with capital; trade: seaborne trade to finance.
nodes.effectRationale: Shifting shipwreck risk to lenders lowers what merchants must charge for carrying bulk goods.

nodes.name: Rhetoric schools
nodes.auditRationale: philosophical_schools: the teaching tradition; citizen_assembly OR jury_courts: the forums where speaking well wins power.
nodes.effectRationale: Trained eloquence is a route into office for able men outside the old families.

nodes.name: Water commissioners
nodes.auditRationale: aqueduct_arcade: the supply to administer; appointed_officials: a permanent office with staff.
nodes.effectRationale: Reliable public water lets crowded blocks stay habitable, so more people live in each dwelling.

nodes.name: Veteran colonies
nodes.auditRationale: standing_army: long-service soldiers to discharge. land_registry: surveyed plots to grant them.
nodes.effectRationale: Veteran settlers form large founding parties and bring marginal land into use.

nodes.name: Extended citizenship
nodes.auditRationale: legal_code_roman: citizenship is a legal status with rights at law. citizen_assembly: it is membership of a citizen body (~700 BCE).
nodes.effectRationale: Citizens may settle and own property anywhere in the state: people move more freely.

nodes.name: Adoptive succession
nodes.auditRationale: succession_law: succession by rule. family_law: adoption is a legal act of family law. Both are A3.
nodes.effectRationale: An heir chosen and designated in advance avoids contested accessions (the five good emperors), so unrest costs less output.

nodes.name: Ruler cult
nodes.auditRationale: sacral_kingship: the ruler is divine or god-sanctioned. provincial_administration: the cult is organized province by province.
nodes.effectRationale: Provincial elites who serve as the ruler's priests tie distant provinces to the centre, so authority reaches further.

nodes.name: Military treatises
nodes.auditRationale: standing_army: a profession to teach. philosophical_schools: systematic written argument.
nodes.effectRationale: Doctrine on scouts and spies lets formations see further.

nodes.name: Public physicians
nodes.auditRationale: medicine_hippocratic: a trained profession to hire; citizen_assembly: the city votes the salary.
nodes.effectRationale: Treatment available to all citizens reduces deaths from injury and illness.

nodes.name: Selection by lot
nodes.auditRationale: citizen_assembly: lots are drawn among citizens (~700 BCE). elected_magistracies: the lot replaced election for offices that already existed (~683 BCE).
nodes.effectRationale: Factions cannot capture office by bribery or force, so their struggles cost less.

nodes.name: Child-support foundations
nodes.auditRationale: public_granaries: the state already feeds citizens; municipal_charter: towns administer the funds.
nodes.effectRationale: A guaranteed allowance for children protects them first when food is scarce.

nodes.name: Agronomic treatises
nodes.prereq: scribal_schools AND (alphabet_vowels OR chinese_script OR abjad)
nodes.auditRationale: scribal_schools: a literate class writes and reads manuals; scripts: Latin, Chinese and Punic (Mago) routes.
nodes.effectRationale: Best practice written down and copied lets estate managers raise the output of each worker.

nodes.name: Chancery enrolment
nodes.auditRationale: appointed_officials: the chancery is a department of officials. royal_archives: enrolment extends archiving to every outgoing order (~2,400 BCE onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Orders that are recorded can be checked and enforced far from the court: authority carries further.

nodes.name: Exchequer audit
nodes.auditRationale: taxation: the Exchequer audits the levy. abacus: accounts were cast on a chequered counting board (~300 BCE onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Audited collectors cannot pocket the difference: more of the levy reaches the treasury.

nodes.name: Parish tithe
nodes.auditRationale: state_religion: a church established by the crown can have its levy enforced by royal law. taxation: assessment of a share of the harvest already exists.
nodes.effectRationale: A tenth of every harvest is held in barns in each parish, so the district keeps larger stores against bad years.

nodes.name: Vernacular literature
nodes.auditRationale: epic_literature: the written literary tradition; paper: cheap enough for lay readers' books.
nodes.effectRationale: Literature lay people can read widens the circle that takes part in civic life; sparing CP use.

civ7.analog: Mono No Aware (Heian Japan unique civic)

nodes.name: Holy war
nodes.auditRationale: state_religion: the faith sanctioning the war is established. standing_army: there are permanent forces to send. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Frontier land granted to settlers under holy war (Reconquista repopulation, crusader states) draws migrants over long distances.

nodes.name: Church-state concordat
nodes.auditRationale: state_religion: an established church. service_tenure: bishops hold lands as fiefs, which is what made investiture contested. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Settled jurisdiction ends the civil wars of the investiture conflict, so unrest costs less output.

nodes.name: Mendicant friars
nodes.auditRationale: monasticism: friars live under a rule. canon_law: the papacy approved and regulated their orders (Gratian ~1,140 CE precedes 1209).
nodes.effectRationale: Preaching and care among the urban poor ease grievance in growing towns.

nodes.name: Peace of God
nodes.auditRationale: feudal_monarchy: the private wars of castellans that the movement restrains. monasticism: Cluniac monks led the peace councils.
nodes.effectRationale: Peasants, ploughing oxen and mills are spared in private wars, so farm work goes on through feuds that once stripped the fields.

nodes.name: Safe-conduct
nodes.auditRationale: royal_envoys: envoys are the first holders of safe-conduct. law_code: the guarantee is enforceable law.
nodes.effectRationale: Guaranteed safety lets travellers and migrants go further.

nodes.name: Commenda partnership
nodes.auditRationale: commercial_law: the partnership is enforced by merchant courts.
nodes.effectRationale: Partnerships give poor but able traders capital, so they rise into the merchant class faster.

nodes.name: Cathedral and madrasa schools
nodes.auditRationale: scribal_schools: the literate teaching tradition; monasticism OR systematic_theology: the religious learning the schools teach.
nodes.effectRationale: Endowed places open clerical and legal careers to poor but able boys.

nodes.name: Bridge trusts
nodes.auditRationale: bridge_stone: the masonry spans the trusts build and keep. monasticism: the brotherhoods and alms that fund them are a religious form of endowment.
nodes.effectRationale: Permanent bridges replace fords and ferries that were closed in flood or slow to cross, so overland journeys go faster.

nodes.name: Water boards
nodes.auditRationale: water_rights: the duty to maintain banks; municipal_charter: a chartered self-governing body with its own levy.
nodes.effectRationale: Maintained dikes stop floods ruining harvests, and drained land is more fertile.

nodes.name: Marcher lordships
nodes.auditRationale: service_tenure: march lords hold land for war service. provincial_administration: the march is a frontier province.
nodes.effectRationale: Empowered frontier lords hold distant border land.

nodes.name: Printed classics
nodes.auditRationale: woodblock_print: the technique; civil_service_examinations: the demand for standard texts.
nodes.effectRationale: Cheap standard texts let far more families educate a son for office: a larger literate class is possible.

nodes.name: Apprenticeship indentures
nodes.auditRationale: craft_guilds: guilds register and supervise the indentures.
nodes.effectRationale: Formal training produces more skilled craftsmen, so the specialist class can be larger.

nodes.name: Sharecropping contracts
nodes.auditRationale: commercial_law: the contract forms of the jurists, which also govern these agrarian partnerships. plough_ard: the plough team the owner usually supplies.
nodes.effectRationale: The owner's plough team and tools go to the family working the land, so tenants who could not afford them farm with full equipment.

nodes.name: Courts of appeal
nodes.auditRationale: legal_code_roman: appeal presupposes a systematic law that higher judges interpret. appointed_officials: appeal judges sit above appointed local judges.
nodes.effectRationale: A wrong verdict can be corrected: injustice by local judges stops turning into lasting grievance.

nodes.name: Public notaries
nodes.auditRationale: legal_code_roman: notarial forms follow Roman law. commercial_law: the notary's main business is merchants' contracts (~800 CE onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Contracts that prove themselves in court let merchants deal at a distance: price gaps close faster.

nodes.name: Primogeniture
nodes.auditRationale: succession_law: the rule of inheritance. service_tenure: fiefs held for service must not be divided. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Realms are no longer partitioned among sons (Carolingian partitions against Capetian continuity), so authority holds over the whole territory.

nodes.name: Slave-soldier corps
nodes.auditRationale: standing_army: a permanent force. coined_wage: the soldiers draw cash pay and stipends.
nodes.effectRationale: Outsiders rise by service into command and office.

nodes.name: Hospitals
nodes.auditRationale: pharmacology: physicians with a pharmacopoeia staff the wards; state_religion: hospitals were founded as pious endowments.
nodes.effectRationale: Nursing and treatment in wards cut deaths from illness among the poor.

nodes.name: Caliphate
nodes.auditRationale: scriptural_canon: the caliph rules a community defined by scripture. state_religion: the faith is established. provincial_administration: the caliphate governed by provinces and a fiscal register.
nodes.effectRationale: The land tax, poll tax on non-Muslims and the diwan register raised extraction across the provinces.

nodes.name: Village by-laws
nodes.auditRationale: kin_council: the village meeting of household heads. heavy_plough: open strip fields worked in common need common rules (~500 CE onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Coordinated rotation, fallow grazing and stinted commons keep the open fields fertile.

nodes.name: Mutual-aid fraternities
nodes.auditRationale: craft_guilds: fraternities grew from guild membership; municipal_charter: they were chartered urban bodies.
nodes.effectRationale: A sickness fund keeps a household fed while its earner cannot work.

nodes.name: Chartered universities
nodes.auditRationale: cathedral_madrasa_schools: the schools from which the masters' guilds grew; jurists: Bologna began as a law school.
nodes.effectRationale: Charters and degrees make the university a durable corporation that matures fast; faculties of medicine (Salerno, Montpellier) train physicians.

nodes.name: Geographic compendia
nodes.auditRationale: translation_patronage: Ptolemy and travellers' reports reach the compilers; cartography: the maps.
nodes.effectRationale: Compiled knowledge of distant lands extends how far exploration can be planned.

nodes.name: Patronage of translation
nodes.auditRationale: philosophical_schools: the Greek works translated; paper: Baghdad's paper mills made mass copying cheap.
nodes.effectRationale: Scholars work with the accumulated learning of several civilizations instead of one.

nodes.name: Intendants
nodes.auditRationale: provincial_administration: intendants supervise existing provinces. royal_post: they report by regular post to the council (~550 BCE onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Removable commissioners replace venal officers who owned their posts: the centre's orders are carried out in distant provinces.

nodes.name: Confessional state
nodes.auditRationale: religious_reform: there are rival confessions to choose between (1517). state_religion: the ruler's church is established.
nodes.effectRationale: Parish registers and church discipline give the state eyes in every parish, extending administrative reach.

nodes.name: Revival movements
nodes.auditRationale: religious_reform: revival builds on lay reading of scripture (1517).
nodes.effectRationale: Orphanages and charity schools (Halle) protect poor children in dearth.

nodes.name: Insurance underwriting
nodes.auditRationale: probability_statistics: premiums are priced from loss rates; stock_exchange: an organised market of risk-takers.
nodes.effectRationale: Cheap, priced insurance lowers the risk charge on every bulk cargo.

nodes.name: Humanist colleges
nodes.auditRationale: humanism: the curriculum; printing_press: standard printed textbooks for whole classes.
nodes.effectRationale: Graded secondary schooling turns out many more educated men than tutors could: a larger professional class.

nodes.name: Organised fire-fighting
nodes.auditRationale: building_regulation: fire prevention by law comes first; municipal_charter: towns fund and command the brigades.
nodes.effectRationale: Fires are put out before they spread, so houses last longer.

nodes.name: Turnpike trusts
nodes.auditRationale: customs_tolls: the toll as a source of finance; road_paved: the engineered road it pays for.
nodes.effectRationale: Tolls pay for maintained surfaces, so coaches and wagons travel faster.

nodes.name: Reason of state
nodes.auditRationale: statecraft_doctrine: the ancient doctrine of state interest. printing_press: the doctrine spread in print. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: The fiscal-military state organizes revenue for its own sake, so it extracts more.

nodes.name: Printed newspapers
nodes.auditRationale: printing_press: the medium; royal_post: weekly news arrived with the post and the papers went out by it.
nodes.effectRationale: Printed prices and ship news tell holders where and when to sell, so stocks reach markets faster.

nodes.name: Bankruptcy law
nodes.auditRationale: commercial_law: the law of merchants' debts (~800 CE onward). legal_code_roman: collective proceedings rest on systematic law.
nodes.effectRationale: Creditors who know what they will recover lend to traders more readily: goods move toward better prices faster.

nodes.name: Army magazines
nodes.auditRationale: standing_army: the army the magazines feed. public_granaries: state grain storage practice.
nodes.effectRationale: Military grain reserves are released to relieve famine.

nodes.name: Corps of engineers
nodes.auditRationale: standing_army: a permanent corps. trace_italienne: engineers are trained for bastion fortification.
nodes.effectRationale: Surveyed, engineered routes cost less to build.

nodes.name: Language academies
nodes.auditRationale: humanism: the study of correct language; printing_press: the dictionaries and grammars they publish.
nodes.effectRationale: One standard written language lets orders and laws be read the same way in every province.

nodes.name: Civil registration
nodes.auditRationale: official_statistics: registration feeds the vital tables (1749 onward). secular_state: registers pass from the parish clergy to the state (1791 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Registered births let relief officers find orphans and foundlings when food is short: children are better protected.

nodes.name: Abolition of internal tolls
nodes.auditRationale: customs_tolls: the tolls being abolished. provincial_administration: a central administration able to replace provincial duties with one frontier tariff.
nodes.effectRationale: Goods cross a country without paying at every river and gate: cheaper haulage.

nodes.name: Prefects
nodes.auditRationale: provincial_intendants: the prefect is the intendant's successor (1635). official_statistics: prefects compiled the departmental statistics of 1801 (1749 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: One chain of command over uniform departments: authority reaches the whole country. 0.05: the template of the modern centralized state.

nodes.name: Industrial exhibitions
nodes.auditRationale: railway: cheap excursion trains brought six million visitors; public_museums: the curatorial model of display.
nodes.effectRationale: Farmers and makers see reapers, ploughs and tools at work and adopt them, so equipped workers gain more.

nodes.name: National literature
nodes.auditRationale: printing_press: the collected tales are printed; nationalism: the cause they serve.
nodes.effectRationale: A shared national story gives peasants and townsmen a common identity, easing grievance between them.

nodes.name: Missionary societies
nodes.auditRationale: missionary_religion: the duty to convert. printing_press: subscription societies print and distribute scripture and reports.
nodes.effectRationale: Missionary travellers (Livingstone) mapped interiors unknown to outsiders, so each exploration reaches further.

nodes.name: Social Christianity
nodes.auditRationale: labour_unions: churches respond to the labour question (1824). state_religion: the established churches take up the cause.
nodes.effectRationale: Church-backed relief and arbitration ease industrial grievance.

nodes.name: Consular service
nodes.auditRationale: merchant_consuls: the older office. resident_embassies: consuls join a state's foreign service.
nodes.effectRationale: Regular market reports let traders close price gaps faster.

nodes.name: River commissions
nodes.auditRationale: great_power_congress: the Rhine commission was created at Vienna and the Danube one at Paris.
nodes.effectRationale: Free navigation and dredged channels cut river haulage costs.

nodes.name: Commodity exchange
nodes.auditRationale: stock_exchange: the organised exchange model; telegraph: prices quoted between markets in minutes.
nodes.effectRationale: Grading and futures let elevators sell stored grain the moment a price is offered.

nodes.name: Agricultural colleges
nodes.auditRationale: agricultural_chemistry: the science taught; technical_academies: the model of a state technical college.
nodes.effectRationale: Trained farmers apply fertilizer, rotation and drainage science, raising yields per field.

nodes.name: Medical education reform
nodes.auditRationale: research_university: medicine taught in a research faculty; germ_theory: the science standardizing it.
nodes.effectRationale: Doctors trained in laboratory medicine save far more lives; landmark of university medicine, hence 0.05.

nodes.name: Normal schools
nodes.auditRationale: compulsory_education: the schools needing teachers; humanist_colleges: the graded-class pedagogy taught.
nodes.effectRationale: Trained teachers make elementary schooling actually teach, opening promotion to more children.

nodes.name: Mining and technical academies
nodes.auditRationale: scientific_societies: experimental science; mineralogy: the core mining science taught at Freiberg.
nodes.effectRationale: Trained mine engineers find and work ore bodies far more efficiently.

civ7.analog: Twelve Gates (Dār al-Fonūn tradition, Qajar unique civic)

nodes.name: Women's higher education
nodes.auditRationale: normal_schools: women trained as teachers first; research_university: the degrees women sought admission to.
nodes.effectRationale: Half the population can now enter the educated professions: a larger specialist class is possible.

nodes.name: Housing reform acts
nodes.auditRationale: building_regulation: standards to apply; public_health_board: slums condemned as a health danger.
nodes.effectRationale: Sound construction standards mean dwellings last longer.

nodes.name: Municipal waterworks
nodes.auditRationale: sanitary_engineering: filtered water and sewers as technique; public_health_board: the authority that commissions them.
nodes.effectRationale: Clean water and sewers end cholera and typhoid outbreaks, cutting deaths at every age.

nodes.name: Assisted emigration
nodes.auditRationale: colonial_administration: the colony pays the passages. land_registry: land sales fund them.
nodes.effectRationale: Paid passages carry migrants across oceans.

nodes.name: Coaling stations
nodes.prereq: state_navy AND (steamboat OR screw_propeller) AND colonial_administration
nodes.auditRationale: state_navy: the fleet that needs coal. steamboat OR screw_propeller: steam ships. colonial_administration: the ports are held as colonies.
nodes.effectRationale: Refuelling ports let steam expeditions go further per voyage.

nodes.name: Geographical societies
nodes.auditRationale: scientific_societies: learned-society form. state_exploration: voyages they fund and publish.
nodes.effectRationale: Funded, surveyed expeditions reach further.

nodes.name: Colonial self-government
nodes.auditRationale: colonial_administration: the colony. ministerial_responsibility: ministers answer to the colonial assembly.
nodes.effectRationale: Settlers govern their own affairs, removing a source of revolt.

nodes.name: New imperialism
nodes.auditRationale: nationalism: empire as national prestige. colonial_administration: the apparatus to rule colonies. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: State-sponsored emigration and settlement schemes send larger founding parties.

nodes.name: Progressivism
nodes.auditRationale: classical_liberalism: progressives reformed liberal capitalism. mass_press: muckraking journalism drove reform. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Pure-food laws, sanitary reform and municipal clean-up lower baseline mortality.

nodes.name: Social democracy
nodes.auditRationale: socialism: the goal. mass_political_party: the party organization. mass_suffrage: the electoral route. All are earlier than 1875.
nodes.effectRationale: Strikes and protest are channelled into parliamentary bargaining, so unrest costs less output.

nodes.name: Advertising
nodes.auditRationale: mass_press: advertising pays for and fills the cheap papers.
nodes.effectRationale: Sellers can reach buyers across a city at once, so stocks clear to market faster.

nodes.name: Telegraph news agencies
nodes.auditRationale: telegraph: the wire; mass_press: the papers that buy the agency's service.
nodes.effectRationale: Prices on distant exchanges are known within hours, so traders close gaps between markets faster.

nodes.name: Industrial arbitration
nodes.auditRationale: labour_unions: organised parties to a dispute; civil_code OR common_law: a court tradition to host the tribunal, in either legal family.
nodes.effectRationale: Settling disputes by award instead of strikes and lockouts costs far less lost output.

nodes.name: Labour exchanges
nodes.auditRationale: merit_civil_service: public offices run by trained clerks; telegraph: vacancies are posted between towns.
nodes.effectRationale: Known vacancies in distant towns draw job-seekers further than rumour would.

nodes.name: Minimum wage
nodes.auditRationale: labour_unions: organised pressure for a floor; factory_inspection: inspectors who can enforce it.
nodes.effectRationale: A wage floor leaves poor households a margin to absorb dearer food.

nodes.name: Workmen's compensation
nodes.auditRationale: factory_inspection: the state already polices workplace hazards; labour_unions: unions pressed the claim.
nodes.effectRationale: An injured worker's family keeps an income, so it does not starve in a hard year.

nodes.name: Administrative courts
nodes.auditRationale: separation_of_powers: a court separate from the administration (1748 onward). appointed_officials: the officials whose acts it reviews.
nodes.effectRationale: Officials held to legal rules everywhere: the centre's rules apply uniformly far from the capital.

nodes.name: Married women's property
nodes.auditRationale: family_law: reforms the law of marriage and estates. classical_liberalism: equal legal personality argued from 1776 onward (Mill).
nodes.effectRationale: Women who own what they earn can keep a shop or trade: larger specialist classes become possible.

nodes.name: Penitentiaries
nodes.auditRationale: civil_police: offenders are arrested by a standing force (1667 onward). enlightenment: Beccaria's and Howard's reform arguments (1687 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Public executions and floggings drew riotous crowds; graded imprisonment removes the spectacle and the disorder.

nodes.name: Trademark law
nodes.auditRationale: patent: trademarks are registered industrial property like patents. railway: national markets carried branded goods far from their maker (1830 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Goods whose quality is known by their mark sell at a distance without inspection: stocks reach markets faster.

nodes.name: Civic ritual
nodes.auditRationale: popular_sovereignty: the nation honoured is the sovereign people. public_games: civic festivals continue public festival practice. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: National symbols and festivals reach every commune, so the state's authority is recognized further from the capital.

nodes.name: Plebiscitary legitimacy
nodes.auditRationale: popular_sovereignty: the people is the source of authority (1776). census: a register of voters is needed.
nodes.effectRationale: A ruler with a popular mandate faces less open resistance, so unrest costs less output.

nodes.name: Colonial regiments
nodes.auditRationale: colonial_administration: the colony raises the troops. mercenary_contracts: soldiers serve for pay under contract.
nodes.effectRationale: Locally raised garrisons hold distant territory.

nodes.name: Compulsory vaccination
nodes.auditRationale: vaccination: the procedure; public_health_board: the authority that enforces it.
nodes.effectRationale: Universal vaccination ends smallpox epidemics, a landmark fall in deaths.

nodes.name: Plebiscitary empire
nodes.auditRationale: plebiscite: the regime is legitimized by popular vote (1799). universal_conscription: it rests on a mass army (1793).
nodes.effectRationale: Prefects appointed from the capital govern every department, extending administrative reach.

nodes.name: Elected town councils
nodes.auditRationale: municipal_charter: the town already governs itself (~90 CE onward). representative_assembly: the council is elected by ratepayers (1188 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Rate-funded councils with their own surveyors build and keep local roads more cheaply.

nodes.name: Elected rural councils
nodes.auditRationale: municipal_corporations: elected councils on the town model (1808). abolition: the zemstvo was created after the emancipation of the serfs (1861) to give the countryside its own government.
nodes.effectRationale: Zemstvo grain reserves and relief committees (1891-92) make stored food reach the hungry.

nodes.name: Friendly societies
nodes.auditRationale: mutual_aid_fraternities: the older mutual fund; coined_wage: weekly dues paid from money wages.
nodes.effectRationale: Sick pay and burial money keep wage-earning families from destitution in hard years.

nodes.name: Social insurance
nodes.auditRationale: friendly_societies: the voluntary model made compulsory; official_statistics: contributions are set from statistics of sickness and age.
nodes.effectRationale: Compulsory sickness cover brings treatment to every insured worker, and security in old age removes a major grievance.

nodes.name: Public libraries
nodes.auditRationale: enlightenment: the ideal of self-improvement through reading; compulsory_education: a public able to read.
nodes.effectRationale: Free books let workers educate themselves into skilled and clerical posts.

nodes.name: Customs modernization
nodes.auditRationale: multilateral_trade_rules: common tariff rules and valuation (1947). computer: declarations processed electronically (1948 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Hours instead of days at the border: cheaper haulage.

nodes.name: Executive budget
nodes.auditRationale: income_tax: the revenue base the budget plans (1799). ministerial_responsibility: the cabinet answers to the chamber for one budget (1782 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Every agency's spending is planned and audited from the centre: authority reaches its far offices.

nodes.name: Fiscal equalization
nodes.auditRationale: income_tax: central revenue to redistribute (1799). federal_republic: transfers between the federation and its states (1787).
nodes.effectRationale: Regions hit by a bad year keep their relief and services funded: households absorb the shortfall.

nodes.name: Competitive procurement
nodes.auditRationale: merit_civil_service: impartial officials run the tender (1854). multilateral_trade_rules: the procurement codes are part of the trade rules (1947).
nodes.effectRationale: Competitive tenders cut the price of roads and works the state pays for.

nodes.name: Sample surveys
nodes.auditRationale: official_statistics: the statistical office runs the surveys (1749 onward). probability_statistics: random sampling and error estimation (1654 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Early crop estimates tell traders and stores where to send grain before prices spike: stocks reach markets faster.

nodes.name: Value-added tax
nodes.auditRationale: income_tax: a mature tax administration. double_entry: the credit-invoice method needs firms' accounts of sales and purchases (~1,300 CE onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Self-checking invoices raise revenue; refunds on inputs and zero-rated exports remove cascading tax from goods that travel.

nodes.name: Tax withholding
nodes.auditRationale: income_tax: the tax being withheld (1799). punched_card_tabulation: payroll machines compute each deduction (1889 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Tax taken at source cannot be evaded or defaulted on: the levy extracts far more. 0.05: the basis of the mass income tax.

nodes.name: Arts councils
nodes.auditRationale: arts_academies: the professional arts world funded; income_tax: the tax base that pays the grants.
nodes.effectRationale: Publicly funded arts widen civic culture beyond the market; sparing CP use.

nodes.name: Cultural institutes
nodes.auditRationale: national_literature: the culture promoted; resident_embassies: the diplomatic network that hosts them.
nodes.effectRationale: Foreigners who have learned the language find it easier to move to the country.

nodes.name: Film industry
nodes.auditRationale: photography: the film image; electric_light: projection.
nodes.effectRationale: Cheap weekly escape for urban workers lowers the output cost of unrest.

nodes.name: Modernist design
nodes.auditRationale: arts_academies: design as a taught discipline; reinforced_concrete: the material of standardized housing.
nodes.effectRationale: Efficient plans and fitted kitchens house more people well in the same dwelling stock.

nodes.name: Ecumenical movement
nodes.auditRationale: religious_toleration: churches accept one another. international_organizations: the World Council of Churches is a permanent international body.
nodes.effectRationale: Cooperation among confessions reduces sectarian conflict.

nodes.name: Liberation theology
nodes.auditRationale: systematic_theology: a theological method. socialism: its social analysis. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Base communities run communal kitchens and mutual aid, so households absorb food shortfalls.

nodes.name: Religious mass movements
nodes.auditRationale: mass_political_party: the mass-membership organization. scriptural_canon: the religious programme. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Their welfare networks feed members and neighbours in hard times.

nodes.name: Academic exchange
nodes.auditRationale: research_university: the institutions exchanging. international_organizations: the programmes.
nodes.effectRationale: Visiting faculty and returning graduates help universities mature faster.

nodes.name: Civil aviation agreements
nodes.auditRationale: international_organizations: the treaty body (ICAO). aircraft: what is regulated.
nodes.effectRationale: Scheduled international flights let migrants travel further.

nodes.name: Development lending
nodes.auditRationale: international_organizations: the lending body. central_banking: the monetary institutions it works with.
nodes.effectRationale: Long-term loans make road building cheaper to finance.

nodes.name: International food aid
nodes.auditRationale: international_organizations: the programme body. public_granaries: the state food-reserve practice it extends.
nodes.effectRationale: Outside stocks relieve famine.

nodes.name: International standards bodies
nodes.auditRationale: international_organizations: the standards body. interchangeable_parts: the practice of standard dimensions.
nodes.effectRationale: Standard containers and parts cut handling costs.

nodes.name: Peacekeeping
nodes.auditRationale: collective_security: the operations are mandated by the collective-security body.
nodes.effectRationale: Protected relief convoys reduce famine deaths in conflict zones.

nodes.name: Shared-river treaties
nodes.auditRationale: river_commissions: standing river diplomacy. irrigation_canal: the water being allocated.
nodes.effectRationale: Assured irrigation water raises yields.

nodes.name: Crop insurance
nodes.auditRationale: probability_statistics: premiums are priced on yield records. cooperatives: the first crop and hail insurers were farmers' mutuals.
nodes.effectRationale: Payouts arrive in the bad year itself, so farm households absorb a crop failure instead of selling stock and land.

nodes.name: Countercyclical demand management
nodes.auditRationale: central_banking: monetary levers; income_tax: fiscal levers; official_statistics: national accounts to steer by.
nodes.effectRationale: Shallower slumps mean unrest and lost work cost less output.

nodes.name: Deposit insurance
nodes.auditRationale: central_banking: a lender behind the banks; limited_liability: bank shareholders' liability is limited, so depositors need cover.
nodes.effectRationale: Household savings survive bank failures, so families can draw on them in a shortfall.

nodes.name: Managed exchange rates
nodes.auditRationale: central_banking: banks that hold reserves and defend a parity; international_organizations: the fund that coordinates them.
nodes.effectRationale: Stable exchange rates remove currency risk from every shipment.

nodes.name: Microfinance
nodes.auditRationale: cooperatives: group lending and joint liability; central_banking: a regulated banking system to charter it.
nodes.effectRationale: Capital for the poorest lets them start trades, so they rise out of labouring poverty faster.

nodes.name: Farm price support
nodes.auditRationale: public_granaries: state stockholding; commodity_exchange: a market price for the state to support.
nodes.effectRationale: Support buying builds large public reserves, so stores can hold more years of demand.

nodes.name: Special economic zones
nodes.auditRationale: multilateral_trade_rules: export zones were designed to plug into the GATT trading order.
nodes.effectRationale: Factory jobs in the zones draw migrants from the countryside.

nodes.name: Distance education
nodes.auditRationale: mass_higher_education: the degrees offered; public_broadcasting OR television: the lectures were broadcast.
nodes.effectRationale: Working adults gain qualifications without leaving work, widening promotion and the skilled share.

nodes.name: Mass higher education
nodes.auditRationale: research_university: the institutions expanded; universal_secondary_education: the qualified entrants.
nodes.effectRationale: Many new campuses with public funding reach maturity fast, and degrees open promotion widely.

nodes.name: Mass literacy campaigns
nodes.auditRationale: compulsory_education: the school system mobilized; mass_press: cheap reading matter for new readers.
nodes.effectRationale: Adults who learn to read can move into skilled and official work: much faster promotion.

nodes.name: Universal secondary education
nodes.auditRationale: compulsory_education: the elementary base extended upward; normal_schools: the trained teachers needed.
nodes.effectRationale: A whole cohort with secondary schooling supports much larger skilled and professional classes.

nodes.name: Community forestry
nodes.auditRationale: nature_conservation: the state already reserves forests for protection. cooperatives: user groups manage the forest as a member association.
nodes.effectRationale: Guarded forests regrow and are cut by plan, so timber yields rise; user groups allot members cheap timber for house repair.

nodes.name: Fisheries management
nodes.auditRationale: nature_conservation: protection of living resources; law_of_nations: maritime jurisdiction over coastal waters.
nodes.effectRationale: Recovered stocks give larger sustainable catches.

nodes.name: National highway programmes
nodes.auditRationale: motor_road: the engineered motorway; turnpike_trusts: the older idea of a road financed for through traffic.
nodes.effectRationale: A national network lets roads run much further between cities.

nodes.name: Planned new towns
nodes.auditRationale: housing_acts: overcrowding to relieve; railway: a line to link the new town to the old.
nodes.effectRationale: Planned overspill moves large parties of settlers at once.

nodes.name: Public housing
nodes.auditRationale: housing_acts: standards and slum clearance; income_tax: subsidy from general taxation.
nodes.effectRationale: Standard designs built in long runs take less labour per home.

nodes.name: Public works relief
nodes.auditRationale: poor_law: public relief of the able-bodied; income_tax: the revenue that pays relief wages.
nodes.effectRationale: Organised relief gangs build more road per worker.

nodes.name: River basin authorities
nodes.auditRationale: water_boards: a body that governs water by catchment; hydroelectric: dams that pay for the scheme.
nodes.effectRationale: Locked, regulated rivers carry barges cheaply, and controlled floods spare the fields.

nodes.name: Rural electrification
nodes.auditRationale: ac_transmission: long high-voltage lines reach scattered farms. cooperatives: rural power was built by member cooperatives on public loans.
nodes.effectRationale: Electric pumps lift groundwater for irrigation in dry spells, so harvests vary less from year to year.

nodes.name: Soil conservation
nodes.auditRationale: nature_conservation: protection of land as a public duty; agricultural_chemistry: soil science to diagnose erosion.
nodes.effectRationale: Soil kept on the fields keeps its fertility, so land yields more.

nodes.name: Commonwealth association
nodes.auditRationale: responsible_colonial_government: self-governing dominions. international_organizations: a permanent association.
nodes.effectRationale: Shared citizenship rights let migrants move between members.

nodes.name: Indigenous land rights
nodes.auditRationale: decolonization: the doctrine of self-determination. human_rights: the rights claimed.
nodes.effectRationale: Recognised title addresses an old grievance.

nodes.name: Overseas departments
nodes.auditRationale: colonial_administration: the former colony. mass_suffrage: residents vote as citizens.
nodes.effectRationale: Integrated territories are governed as home provinces.

nodes.name: States reorganisation
nodes.auditRationale: decolonization: a newly independent state. federal_republic: units to redraw.
nodes.effectRationale: Provinces matching language groups reduce disorder.

nodes.name: Nonviolent resistance
nodes.auditRationale: mass_press: public opinion is the lever. mass_political_party: mass organization. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Protest that refuses violence costs far less output than riot or insurrection.

nodes.name: Developmental state
nodes.auditRationale: central_planning: plans and targets. nationalism: development as national goal. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: State-led industrialization and technical schooling enlarge the skilled and specialist classes.

nodes.name: Liberal internationalism
nodes.auditRationale: classical_liberalism: free trade and rights. international_organizations: permanent international bodies. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Lower tariffs and open sea lanes close price gaps between countries.

nodes.name: Multiculturalism
nodes.auditRationale: secular_state: equality of faiths. human_rights: equal dignity of all residents. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Recognition and settlement support make immigration easier, so people move more freely.

nodes.name: Neoliberalism
nodes.auditRationale: classical_liberalism: free-market tradition. central_banking: monetarist policy works through the central bank. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Deregulation of freight (trucking, rail and shipping, 1980) cut haulage costs.

nodes.name: Pan-national movements
nodes.auditRationale: nationalism: the shared identity. international_organizations: regional bodies. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Regional free-movement agreements let people travel further.

nodes.name: Mass populism
nodes.auditRationale: mass_suffrage: populists win elections. labour_unions: they incorporate the unions. nationalism: they speak for the nation. All are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Wage gains and recognition for organized workers ease grievance.

nodes.name: Vanguard party
nodes.auditRationale: socialism: the goal. mass_political_party: the party form, remade as a disciplined vanguard. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Party cadres promote workers and peasants into management and office.

nodes.name: Famine early warning
nodes.auditRationale: earth_observation: satellite crop and rainfall monitoring; international_organizations: the agencies that run and act on it.
nodes.effectRationale: Households and relief agencies prepare in time, so a shortfall is absorbed rather than turning into famine.

nodes.name: Public opinion polling
nodes.auditRationale: mass_press: polls are commissioned and published by papers; probability_statistics: sampling theory.
nodes.effectRationale: Governments learn of grievances before they harden, and of conditions in distant regions without sending officials.

nodes.name: Script and language reform
nodes.auditRationale: compulsory_education: reform is delivered through schools; nationalism: reform serves the nation-state.
nodes.effectRationale: Easier reading opens promotion to more people, and one standard language carries orders across the country.

nodes.name: Social media
nodes.auditRationale: internet: the network; personal_computer: the devices on which ordinary users publish.
nodes.effectRationale: Diaspora networks share jobs, routes and housing instantly, so people move more freely.

nodes.name: Universal telephone service
nodes.auditRationale: telephone: the network; public_postal_service: the universal-service principle extended from letters.
nodes.effectRationale: Farms and villages far out can order, sell and call for help by telephone, widening the hinterland a town draws on.

nodes.name: Collective bargaining law
nodes.auditRationale: labour_unions: the bargaining party; industrial_arbitration: the state's earlier role in labour disputes.
nodes.effectRationale: Recognised bargaining turns workplace complaints into contracts, so grievance builds more slowly.

nodes.name: Employment guarantee
nodes.auditRationale: income_tax: the guarantee is paid from general revenue. mass_suffrage: rural voters made work on demand a legal right.
nodes.effectRationale: When harvests fail, labourers claim wages at once instead of migrating or starving; the Maharashtra scheme carried millions through the 1972 drought.

nodes.name: Guest-worker programmes
nodes.auditRationale: labour_exchanges: recruitment offices; sworn_treaties: bilateral recruitment agreements.
nodes.effectRationale: Organised recruitment moves workers across borders in large numbers.

nodes.name: Occupational safety agencies
nodes.auditRationale: factory_inspection: the inspectorate; workmens_compensation: employers already bear the cost of injury.
nodes.effectRationale: Standards for chemicals, machinery and construction cut deaths at work.

nodes.name: Unemployment insurance
nodes.auditRationale: social_insurance: the contributory model; labour_exchanges: benefit is paid while the claimant seeks work through the exchange.
nodes.effectRationale: Laid-off workers keep an income, so slumps cause less disorder and lost output.

nodes.name: Public vocational training
nodes.auditRationale: apprenticeship: the training contract; compulsory_education: the school system it is joined to.
nodes.effectRationale: Recognised qualifications let workers' children move into skilled trades faster.

nodes.name: International arbitration
nodes.auditRationale: commercial_law: merchants' own law of contract. international_organizations: the convention binds many states (1865 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Enforceable awards cut the risk premium on long-distance contracts: cheaper trade.

nodes.name: Consumer protection
nodes.auditRationale: civil_code: contract law on which buyers' rights are built (1804). antitrust: consumer law grew out of competition law (1890 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Buyers who trust distant sellers widen markets: price gaps close faster.

nodes.name: Equal pay law
nodes.auditRationale: womens_suffrage: women voters pressed the law (1893 onward). labour_unions: pay is set by bargaining that the law now constrains (1824 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Equal pay makes skilled work worth training for: larger specialist classes become possible.

nodes.name: Land to the tiller
nodes.auditRationale: land_registry: title must be recorded to be transferred. mass_suffrage: enfranchised peasants made redistribution a political demand (1820 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Owner-cultivators keep the whole crop and work harder and better (Japan, Korea, Taiwan after 1946). 0.04: a landmark reform.

nodes.name: Land titling
nodes.auditRationale: land_registry: titles are entered in a public register. civil_code: codified property law defines what a title secures.
nodes.effectRationale: Families with secure title invest in solid walls and roofs instead of temporary shelters, so their homes last longer.

nodes.name: Legal aid
nodes.auditRationale: bill_of_rights: a right to a fair trial (1215 onward). jurists: a legal profession whose services the state now pays for (~100 BCE onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Poor households can defend their wages, tenancies and liberty in court instead of losing them: fewer are pushed down and more rise.

nodes.name: Patent Cooperation Treaty
nodes.auditRationale: patent: national patent systems. international_organizations: the treaty is administered by an international bureau (1865 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Worldwide prior-art search keeps research teams from repeating work already patented elsewhere.

nodes.name: Refugee protection
nodes.auditRationale: international_organizations: the League's High Commissioner issued the first papers (1865 onward). law_of_nations: duties between states toward foreigners (1625).
nodes.effectRationale: Papers and a duty not to return refugees let them cross several borders to safety: migrants travel further.

nodes.name: Tenancy protection
nodes.auditRationale: land_registry: tenancies are registered. civil_code: the law of leases is codified and courts can enforce fixed terms (1804 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Secure tenants invest in the land (Banerjee, Gertler and Ghatak on Operation Barga): land yields more.

nodes.name: Constitutional court
nodes.auditRationale: judicial_review: courts may void laws (1803). written_constitution: the court guards a written text.
nodes.effectRationale: Disputes over power are settled in court instead of the street, and federal law applies uniformly across regions.

nodes.name: Independent electoral administration
nodes.auditRationale: secret_ballot: the vote to protect (1856). merit_civil_service: non-partisan officials to run it (1854).
nodes.effectRationale: Citizens who regard the government as fairly chosen comply with taxes more readily.

nodes.name: Cult of personality
nodes.auditRationale: state_propaganda: the cult is built by propaganda (1917). mass_political_party: the party venerates its leader.
nodes.effectRationale: The leader's image and directives reach every village and workplace, extending administrative reach.

nodes.name: Power-sharing
nodes.auditRationale: mass_suffrage: each community is represented by vote. religious_toleration: communities of different faiths accept one another. Both are earlier.
nodes.effectRationale: Each community holds a guaranteed share and veto, which eases grievance and reduces violent disorder.

nodes.name: Term limits
nodes.auditRationale: separation_of_powers: an elected executive to limit. mass_suffrage: the electorate whose choices term limits renew.
nodes.effectRationale: Forced turnover opens top offices to new people.

nodes.name: Transitional justice
nodes.auditRationale: human_rights: the standard abuses are judged by (1948). international_tribunals: the precedent of trying a fallen regime (1945).
nodes.effectRationale: Acknowledgment and reparations for past abuses ease the grievances of victims.

nodes.name: Counter-insurgency doctrine
nodes.auditRationale: military_intelligence: insurgency is fought with information. colonial_administration: the doctrine came from colonial emergencies.
nodes.effectRationale: Unrest disrupts less output where order is restored.

nodes.name: Intelligence agencies
nodes.auditRationale: general_staff: the intelligence branch of the staff. radio: signals interception.
nodes.effectRationale: Formations receive intelligence beyond their own sight.

nodes.name: Strategic stockpiles
nodes.auditRationale: total_mobilization: stockpiles prepare for the next mobilisation.
nodes.effectRationale: Reserves are released to markets faster in shortages.

nodes.name: Veterans' benefits
nodes.auditRationale: universal_conscription: the veterans. compulsory_education: the school system that admits them.
nodes.effectRationale: Paid education moves veterans into skilled classes.

nodes.name: Ration books
nodes.auditRationale: total_mobilization: rationing is part of directing the war economy.
nodes.effectRationale: Fair shares let households absorb shortfalls.

nodes.name: Administrative procedure law
nodes.auditRationale: administrative_courts: courts review agency decisions (1799). merit_civil_service: the agencies bound by the procedure (1854).
nodes.effectRationale: People heard before a rule is made protest less after it: unrest costs less output.

nodes.name: Agricultural extension
nodes.auditRationale: research_university: land-grant colleges train the agents (1810 onward). agricultural_chemistry: the fertiliser and soil science they teach (1813 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Demonstrated methods spread from college to farm within a season: each farmer produces more.

nodes.name: Anti-corruption commission
nodes.auditRationale: merit_civil_service: a service with rules to enforce (1854). civil_police: the commission's investigators and powers of arrest come from police practice (1667 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Less leakage in collection: taxes extract more of what is owed.

nodes.name: Digital identity
nodes.auditRationale: e_government: the services the ID unlocks (~2,000 CE). civil_registration: the identity records it is built on (1792).
nodes.effectRationale: Portable entitlements (India's One Nation One Ration Card) remove a reason not to move.

nodes.name: Disaster management
nodes.auditRationale: official_statistics: needs are assessed from population data (1749 onward). radio_broadcasting: warnings reach everyone at once (1920 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Relief planned and stocked in advance reaches the stricken before hunger kills: fewer famine deaths.

nodes.name: Digital government
nodes.auditRationale: internet: services delivered online (1983 onward). merit_civil_service: the bureaucracy being digitized (1854).
nodes.effectRationale: Distance from the capital stops mattering for a service delivered online: administrative reach extends further.

nodes.name: Freedom of information
nodes.auditRationale: press_freedom: journalists use the files (1766 onward). merit_civil_service: a records-keeping bureaucracy bound by rules (1854).
nodes.effectRationale: Exposed abuses are corrected instead of resented in silence.

nodes.name: Land consolidation
nodes.auditRationale: mechanised_agriculture: tractors and combines need large regular fields. land_registry: holdings must be registered before they can be exchanged.
nodes.effectRationale: Machines lose little time turning and travelling between large compact fields, so equipped farmers get more from their tools.

nodes.name: Road traffic law

future.system: freight-time consumer (ADR-032 section 7 design intent: delivery delay, carriage term, route tonnage caps)
future.description: regulated motor traffic raises road speed and throughput once a system consumes travel time

nodes.auditRationale: automobile_mass: mass motor traffic to regulate (1913). civil_police: traffic police enforce the rules (1667 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Uniform rules and signs keep mixed traffic moving: faster overland travel.

nodes.name: Livestock disease campaigns
nodes.auditRationale: vaccine_lab: the vaccines the campaigns deliver. international_organizations: a standing international office coordinates reporting and eradication.
nodes.effectRationale: Herds no longer die in plague years, so each herder keeps and raises far more stock.

nodes.name: Child nutrition programmes
nodes.auditRationale: epidemiology: weighing and measuring children identifies who is malnourished. oral_rehydration: diarrhoea treatment is part of the same village package.
nodes.effectRationale: Under-fives at risk are found early and fed, so fewer young children die when food runs short.

nodes.name: Drug regulation
nodes.auditRationale: public_health_board: a regulating authority; sulfonamides: the 1937 sulfanilamide poisoning prompted the 1938 Act.
nodes.effectRationale: Only tested drugs reach patients, so university medicine saves more lives.

nodes.name: Mass immunization programmes
nodes.auditRationale: compulsory_vaccination: the duty to vaccinate; vaccine_lab: new vaccines for measles, polio and diphtheria.
nodes.effectRationale: Measles and whooping cough kill malnourished children first; immunised children survive famine years.

nodes.name: International health regulations
nodes.auditRationale: public_health_board: national quarantine powers; international_organizations: the body that harmonises them.
nodes.effectRationale: Agreed rules replace arbitrary quarantines that held up cargo, and early warning contains epidemics.

nodes.name: Universal health care
nodes.auditRationale: social_insurance: health cover by contribution; public_hospitals: the hospital network nationalised or contracted.
nodes.effectRationale: Everyone can see a doctor and enter hospital, a landmark fall in deaths.

nodes.name: Primary health care
nodes.auditRationale: public_physicians: publicly paid first-line care; international_health_regulations: the WHO framework that set the Alma-Ata goals.
nodes.effectRationale: Care reaches villages without hospitals, cutting deaths from common illness and in famine.

nodes.name: Clerical republic
nodes.auditRationale: religious_political_movements: the movement that takes power (1928). written_constitution and mass_suffrage: an elected parliament and president under a constitution.
nodes.effectRationale: Revolutionary construction foundations built rural roads cheaply with volunteer labour (Construction Jihad, 1979), so paths cost less to build.

nodes.name: Dominant-party system
nodes.auditRationale: mass_political_party: the dominant party. mass_suffrage: elections are held and won. Both are 19th century.
nodes.effectRationale: Factions inside the governing party bargain over demands, absorbing grievance.

nodes.name: Personalist dictatorship
nodes.auditRationale: personality_cult: the ruler's cult (1929). standing_army: the force that keeps him in power.
nodes.effectRationale: The ruler's network extracts revenue from monopolies and concessions directly, raising extraction.

nodes.name: Semi-presidential republic
nodes.auditRationale: ministerial_responsibility: the cabinet answers to parliament. separation_of_powers: a separately elected president. mass_suffrage: both are popularly elected.
nodes.effectRationale: A president able to dissolve parliament and appoint governments ends chronic cabinet crises (the Fourth Republic), so disorder costs less output.

nodes.name: Supranational union
nodes.auditRationale: customs_union: the common market's base (1834). international_organizations: permanent treaty bodies (1865).
nodes.effectRationale: A single market closes price gaps and free movement lets people relocate across member states.

nodes.name: Elected village councils
nodes.auditRationale: zemstvo_councils: elected rural government (1864). mass_suffrage: every villager votes (1820 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Relief allocated by people who know each household reaches those in need: households absorb shortfalls.

nodes.name: Metropolitan government
nodes.auditRationale: municipal_corporations: the town councils being federated (1808). automobile_mass: suburbs spread beyond city limits by car (1913).
nodes.effectRationale: A city governed with its suburbs draws on a wider region.

nodes.name: Participatory budgeting
nodes.auditRationale: municipal_corporations: an elected city government with an investment budget (1808). mass_suffrage: every resident takes part (1820 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Works chosen and watched by the neighbourhood are built with less waste.

nodes.name: Proportional representation
nodes.auditRationale: mass_suffrage: a mass electorate (1820 onward). mass_political_party: seats are allotted to party lists (1830 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Minorities represented in the chamber accumulate less grievance against it.

nodes.name: Regional self-government
nodes.auditRationale: provincial_administration: the regions already exist as administrative units. mass_suffrage: their governments are now elected (1820 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Regional governments administer what the capital could not reach: administrative reach extends.

nodes.name: Reserved seats
nodes.auditRationale: mass_suffrage: excluded groups vote. written_constitution: the reservation is a constitutional guarantee (1653 onward).
nodes.effectRationale: Reserved office raises members of excluded groups into public positions (Pande 2003): faster promotion.

nodes.name: Conditional cash transfers
nodes.auditRationale: school_meals: welfare tied to school attendance; official_statistics: a registry to target poor households.
nodes.effectRationale: Paid attendance keeps poor children in school, and the cash protects them in dearth.

nodes.name: School meals
nodes.auditRationale: compulsory_education: children are in school to be fed; poor_law: public relief in kind.
nodes.effectRationale: A daily meal at school protects children when food is scarce at home.

nodes.name: Universal social security
nodes.auditRationale: social_insurance: the contributory schemes unified; income_tax: general taxation funds the safety net.
nodes.effectRationale: A universal safety net means no one starves in a crisis and households weather shortfalls.

nodes.name: National accounts
nodes.auditRationale: official_statistics: the statistical office; income_tax: returns supply the income data.
nodes.effectRationale: Knowing the size of each sector lets the treasury set and collect taxes closer to capacity.

nodes.name: National laboratories
nodes.auditRationale: research_university: the scientists and methods; nuclear_physics: the field that first demanded big science.
nodes.effectRationale: Teams and instruments at national scale raise research yield.

nodes.name: Open access science
nodes.auditRationale: internet: free distribution; science_policy: funders mandate open publication.
nodes.effectRationale: Every institution reads all research without paywalls, cutting research cost.

nodes.name: Operations research
nodes.auditRationale: radar: the first problems studied were radar operations; probability_statistics: the mathematics.
nodes.effectRationale: Optimized routing and loading cuts the cost of hauling goods.

nodes.name: Think tanks
nodes.auditRationale: research_university: trained social scientists; parliamentary_government OR mass_political_party: the demand for policy analysis.
nodes.effectRationale: Organized policy research raises the rate of civic innovation; sparing CP use.
